jobs.title: HR Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are?

As a trusted provider of aviation component services, STRADE leads the way in ensuring fast, innovative and high-quality service delivery to customers worldwide through a digitalized operating model. Established in 2021, we became a subsidiary of SR Technics in 2022 and now operate as an independent unit and intrapreneurship venture. Our focus revolves around managing a vast asset base of aircraft components and providing round-the-clock support to airlines, MROs, and trade partners.
The international team of 70 professionals is strategically located across the globe with key hubs in Zurich, Miami, Kuala Lumpur, Amsterdam, and Belgrade.

Position Description

As an HR Manager, you will be responsible for managing HR processes and activities across STRADE’s international operations. This is a broad, hands-on role focused on putting STRADE’s HR approach into practice and ensuring effective HR processes across different locations. You will work closely with management and team leaders, while coordinating with local partners, particularly for payroll and legal matters. The role combines the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes with the practical, day-to-day HR work needed to support employees and managers.

What You’ll Do

HR Strategy Execution & People Development

Execute and roll out STRADE’s global HR strategy and priorities as defined together with management team.
Apply and continuously improve HR processes, policies and initiatives in line with STRADE’s culture, values and business needs.
Drive initiatives related to employee engagement, performance, talent and leadership development, including succession planning, as well as setting up and analyzing engagement surveys and following up on the results.
Support change management and other company-wide people initiatives in line with STRADE’s values.

Recruitment & Employee Lifecycle

Coordinate and support the overall recruitment process, working closely with team leaders on hiring and promotion and supporting them in taking ownership of people decisions.
Manage the full employee lifecycle across locations, from onboarding through development, compensation and benefits, employee relations and offboarding.
Manage employee relations and provide HR guidance and support to managers and employees, working with local specialists where required.
Ensure HR processes are consistently applied while adapting them where needed to local requirements.

HR Operations

Handle day-to-day HR matters and provide practical support to managers and employees.
Manage HR administration, including payroll inputs, employment contracts, employee documentation, HR data and reporting to relevant internal stakeholders.
Apply STRADE’s compensation and benefits strategy and coordinate its administration with local providers.
Coordinate and manage STRADE’s external HR providers, including payroll, legal, benefits and other HR service providers across its locations.
Manage the HR administration budget in line with agreed objectives.

Compliance & Local HR Support

Ensure HR practices comply with applicable local employment laws, regulations and relevant standards, working with local specialists where required.
Apply and maintain STRADE’s HR policies, frameworks and best practices across locations.

Who You Are

You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in handling diverse HR functions in an international environment.
Your background includes HR operations, hire-to-retire administration and policy application.
Throughout your experience, you have been involved in the full hire-to-retire process (labor law, compensation, recruitment, etc.).
Working closely with management and team leaders comes naturally to you, while you are equally comfortable executing independently.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills enable you to work effectively in diverse cultural environments.
A university degree in HR Management, Business Administration, Psychology, or equivalent complements your professional experience.
You have an excellent command of English.

And - Why join us?

Our values always guide our actions. We do not beat around the bush. We are learning, constantly. We dare to dream big. As a team we achieve more. For all roles, we are seeking authentic team players guided by an entrepreneurial spirit, integrity, and a global mindset.

We know great talent comes in many forms. We're building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive — and we especially encourage women and underrepresented talent to apply. If this role excites you and your experience aligns with the key requirements, we’d love to hear from you — even if you don’t meet every single point.

The greatest advantage of joining our team is the opportunity to elevate your career while working in an innovative environment set to revolutionize the aviation industry. And additionally:
Vibrant company culture, centered around our four values “1 Team”, “Extreme Drive”, “Constant Learning” and “Always Real”
Hybrid work environment fully supportive of flexibility to arrange your work in line with your lifestyle and personal context
Personal and professional development opportunities
Benchmark driven compensation rewarding growth

Thank you for your interest.
By submitting your application, you give your consent that all personal data you have submitted here may be processed by us for the purposes of candidate selection process in our company.

jobs.description:
Over Fair Priced Vintage

Fair Priced Vintage maakt unieke vintage fashion toegankelijk met eerlijke, vaste prijzen. We geven kleding een tweede leven en maken duurzame mode betaalbaar en leuk. Met onze grootschalige vintage markten brengen we vintage door heel Europa naar een breed publiek. Ondertussen groeien we hard en bouwen we aan een jong en internationaal team.

Over de functie

Voor ons team zijn we op zoek naar een praktische en mensgerichte HR Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de dagelijkse HR-zaken binnen Fair Priced Vintage.
Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers en managers en werkt nauw samen met het management. Je helpt onze medewerkers, zorgt dat HR-processen goed geregeld zijn en draagt actief bij aan een fijne en sterke bedrijfscultuur.
Deze functie past goed bij iemand met 1–2 jaar ervaring in HR die graag initiatief neemt, goed georganiseerd is en klaar is om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen binnen een snelgroeiend bedrijf.

Wat ga je doen?

Je begeleidt het volledige proces rondom medewerkers: van recruitment en onboarding tot contracten en uitdiensttreding.
Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers en managers bij HR-gerelateerde vragen.
Je coördineert het recruitmentproces, voert sollicitatiegesprekken en ondersteunt managers bij het aannemen van nieuwe collega’s.
Je houdt de personeelsadministratie bij, waaronder personeelsdossiers, contracten, verlof en werktijden.
Je coördineert ziekteverzuim en re-integratie in samenwerking met externe HR- en arbodienstverleners.
Je ondersteunt managers bij personeelskwesties, functioneringsgesprekken en andere HR-vraagstukken.
Je denkt mee over en verbetert onze HR-processen en -beleid naarmate we verder groeien.
Je draagt bij aan een positieve bedrijfscultuur door leuke en waardevolle initiatieven en events voor medewerkers te organiseren.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt 1–2 jaar ervaring in HR of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je hebt een relevante opleiding op het gebied van HR.
Je bent sterk in organiseren en communiceren.
Je bent proactief, praktisch ingesteld en werkt graag met mensen.
Je kunt goed zelfstandig werken en vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.
Je hebt een goede basiskennis van het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht, of bent gemotiveerd om dit snel te leren.
Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands. Spreek je ook goed Engels? Dat is mooi meegenomen.
Ervaring binnen retail, fashion, e-commerce of een snelgroeiende organisatie is een pré.

Interesse
?
Lijkt deze functie je interessant en wil je onderdeel worden van ons team?
Stuur dan je cv en motivatiebrief naar business@fairpricedvintage.com.
We nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op!

Reports to: Director HR
Location: Amsterdam, the Netherlands

Company Description

Segway-Ninebot is a global pioneer in high-tech electric mobility, dedicated to revolutionizing how people move. Our mission is to simplify the movement of people and goods, making life more convenient and captivating. Beyond leading innovation in micro-mobility, we are deeply engaged in service robotics and intelligent short-term transportation. With the headquarters stationed in Beijing, China, we focus on research, development, design, and distribution of cutting-edge short-distance transportation solutions. Segway-Ninebot Europe operates with branches in The Netherlands, Spain, France, and Germany.

General Description

The HR Business Partner will work closely with the Director HR and support daily HR activities with the European organization and serve as an advisor for managers on various HR themes, including recruitment, labor law questions, absenteeism.

Key Responsibilities

Responsible for clear HR processes and supporting systems, including the execution of HR and payroll administration. Additionally, you serve as the point of contact for external suppliers and advisors, such as recruitment agencies, payroll companies and occupational health services.
Provide HR advice and guidance to managers and employees on a wide range of topics, ensuring alignment with company policies and legal requirements
Facilitate full cycle recruitment activities as needed, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, conducting reference checks and selecting candidates. Works with hiring manager(s) to ensure interviewing practices are followed.
Lead offboarding process for leavers and lead onboarding process for new employees including preparing offer letters/employment contracts, payroll documents, etc andensure new employees feel at home quickly and understand what is expected of them.

Qualifications and Skills

Fluency in English and Dutch required
Bachelor’s degree in human resources
2+ years of human resources employee relations, payroll and recruitment work experience
Comprehensive understanding of European employment laws and regulations
Team player
Strong interpersonal and customer service skills

jobs.title: Group Human Resources Manager
jobs.description:
**Job description**

**Group Human Resources Manager**

**Location: Ireland \& UK (Multi\-site)**

**Contract: Full\-time \| Permanent**

We are a proudly independent Irish hotel and hospitality group with a reputation for genuine service, warm hospitality and memorable guest experiences. Our success is built on our people, and we are currently recruiting for an experienced Human Resources Manager to join our group's management team.

You will help shape the future of our organisation by creating an exceptional employee experience, developing outstanding leaders and fostering a culture where people feel valued, supported and inspired to deliver their very best.

If you are passionate about hospitality, believe that engaged colleagues create exceptional guest experiences, and thrive in a fast\-paced, people\-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting directly to the Director of People \& Culture, you will manage the groups operational human resources function across our portfolio of hotels and hospitality businesses. As a trusted adviser to the Senior Team \& General Managers, you will help manage and deliver progressive people strategy that supports our operational leaders while strengthening our culture and values.

**Key Responsibilities**

Working closely with the Director of People \& Culture, you will support the delivery of the Group People Strategy, ensuring the effective implementation of people initiatives across all business units.

**You'll manage our people operations agenda by:**

Manage the day\-to\-day business of the Human Resources Department, supporting our operational leaders in all HR related matters.

Manage all the company’s HR policies, systems and practices and ensure full compliance with all of the relevant legislation.

Management and oversight of recruitment platforms, induction procedures and onboarding processes.

Management and oversight of all mandatory training and monthly skills training calendar and initiatives in line with company policy and mandatory requirements and assist in assessing ongoing training requirements as appropriate.

Manage employee data, employee personnel records and HR systems in line with company policy and GDPR requirements.

Providing guidance on employee relations, employment legislation and organisational change and update all company HR related documentation as required.

Manage and oversee all the company’s employee relations obligations including disciplinaries and grievances ensuring full and proper process is followed at all times.

Support workforce planning and organisational design initiatives.

Produce and analyse HR metrics, reporting and insights to support decision\-making.

Coach and develop hotel management teams to strengthen people leadership capability.

Deliver timely and effective administrative support to the group and operational teams on performance management and related HR related.

Assist in TUPE processes related to acquisitions where necessary.

Provide direct HR administration support to team members on all relevant matters and visit properties as and when required.

Ensure effective and timely communication on all HR related matters to all relevant stakeholders.

Complete other duties as requested by the Director of People \& Culture or senior management.

**About You**

**We're looking for a confident, authentic leader who combines commercial awareness with genuine passion for people and the following skills and attributes:** 

Significant senior HR leadership experience, ideally within hospitality, hotels, leisure or another customer\-focused environment.

Strong operational Human Resources experience and an understanding of operational pressures.

Strong knowledge of Irish \& UK employment legislation and HR best practice.

Demonstrated success in organisational development, employee engagement, talent management and change leadership.

Outstanding communication, coaching and relationship\-building skills.

The confidence to make sound decisions while remaining approachable and collaborative.

A recognised qualification in Human Resource Management, Business or a related discipline

**Above all, you'll be someone who:**

Leads with integrity and authenticity.

Acts as an ambassador for the company’s mission, vision and values.

Manages and leads with a positive and can\-do mindset.

Builds trusted relationships at every level of the organisation.

Sees people as our greatest competitive advantage.

Enjoys being visible, accessible and connected to operational teams.

Is resilient, adaptable and energised by a dynamic hospitality environment.

**Why Join Us?**

**This is more than a Human Resources role—it's an opportunity to help shape the future of a growing independent hospitality group where people truly matter.**

**In return, you'll find:**

A seat on the groups management team.

The chance to assist in building a people\-first culture across a portfolio of distinctive hotels and hospitality businesses.

A collaborative, values\-led environment where your ideas and expertise will make a lasting impact.

A competitive salary and executive benefits package.

Opportunities for continued professional development and leadership growth.

**Our Commitment**

**We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected and able to succeed. We value diversity of thought, background and experience and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates.**

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: €60,000\.00\-€75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Bike to work scheme
* Company events
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Free or subsidised travel
* On\-site parking
* Work from home

Experience:

* HR Management: 2 years (preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Remote

jobs.title: Strategic Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Ehrenamtsgewinnung
jobs.description:
**Strategic Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Ehrenamtsgewinnung**

**Teilzeit \| 20 Wochenstunden \| remote (Wohnsitz in NI oder NW bevorzugt) \| Start ab 15\.10\.2026**

Strategischer Weitblick, Gespür für Menschen \& Mut zum Mitgestalten: Gute Mobbingprävention braucht die richtigen Menschen. Werde zur treibenden Kraft für das Wachstum unserer Community!

Entwickle skalierbare Recruiting\- und Ehrenamtsgewinnungsstrukturen – von der Strategie über wirkungsvolle Prozesse bis zur Umsetzung gewinnst du Menschen für unsere Mission.

Jeden Tag erleben Kinder und Jugendliche Gewalt und Mobbing in der Schule. Wir bei Zeichen gegen Mobbing e. V. treten an, um das zu ändern. Damit unsere Vision von einem mobbingfreien Miteinander an Schulen Realität wird, brauchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen.

Als **Strategic Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/w/d)** in Teilzeit sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Wirkung wachsen kann: Jede Person, die du für uns begeistert, bedeutet mehr Schutz und Unterstützung für betroffene Schüler:innen. Du gewinnst nicht nur „Personal“. Du baust eine Gemeinschaft auf, die unsere Mission trägt.

**Deine Rolle bei uns**

**Menschen begeistern:** Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson, die erste Stimme und das Gesicht für Interessierte. Du berätst sie empathisch zu ehrenamtlichen sowie hauptamtlichen Möglichkeiten und gestaltest eine wertschätzende Candidate Journey bis zum Onboarding.

**Strategisches Recruiting:** Du denkst Ehrenamtsgewinnung ganzheitlich: Wie erreichen wir die richtigen Menschen? Dazu optimierst du digitale Kanäle wie Social Media, Ehrenamtsplattformen und Website, testest neue Strategien und wertest ihre Wirkung aus. So sorgst du für einen verlässlichen Interessiertenzufluss, insbesondere bei jungen Menschen zwischen 18 und 26 Jahren.

**Prozess\-Gestaltung:** Du begleitest Auswahlprozesse für Haupt\- und Ehrenamtliche und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Recruiting\-Prozesse wertschätzend und professionell ablaufen. Dabei setzt du nicht nur bestehende Prozesse um, sondern analysierst Bedarfe, entwickelst Lösungen und überführst Wissen in verständliche, nutzbare Standards. Digitale Prozesse und Automatisierungen helfen dir dabei, Strukturen zu schaffen, die mit uns wachsen.

**Netzwerk \& Kooperation:** Du baust Brücken zu Hochschulen, Initiativen und Netzwerken und entwickelst Recruitingansätze, die regional funktionieren und auf weitere Regionen übertragbar sind. So stärkst du unsere Sichtbarkeit als attraktive Organisation für ehrenamtliches Engagement und persönliches Wachstum.

**Das bringst du mit**

* **Profil:** **Mindestens zwei Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung** im Bereich Strategisches Recruiting, Talent Acquisition oder Referent:in für Personalgewinnung **–** idealerweise mit Bezug zum Non\-Profit\-Sektor.
* **Strategie \& Weiterentwicklung:** Du kannst aus Ideen, Bedarfen oder noch unklaren Ausgangslagen konkrete Lösungen entwickeln. Du hast Freude daran, Recruitingstrategien zu konzipieren, auszuprobieren, auszuwerten und auf Basis der Ergebnisse weiterzuentwickeln.
* **Kommunikationsstärke:** Du findest instinktiv den richtigen Ton für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen, schaffst Vertrauen und kannst Menschen für gesellschaftlichen Impact begeistern.
* **Digitale Affinität:** Du hast echtes Interesse an modernen Recruiting\-Kanälen, Social Media, digitalen Prozessen und Automatisierungen und nutzt sie, um Personalgewinnung wirksamer und effizienter zu gestalten.
* **Struktur \& Umsetzungsstärke:** Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und verbindlich. Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Anfragen und Fristen den Überblick, setzt Prioritäten klug und bringst Aufgaben zum Abschluss. Gleichzeitig kannst du Abläufe in klare Prozesse, Leitfäden und Verantwortlichkeiten übersetzen, die im Alltag wirklich funktionieren.
* **Pluspunkt Region:** Da wir unsere Vernetzung in bestimmten Regionen stärken wollen, ist ein Wohnsitz in Niedersachsen oder Nordrhein\-Westfalen ein toller Bonus. Die Stelle bleibt dennoch zu 100 % remote.

**Warum wir: Deine Benefits**

* **Maximaler Impact:** Deine Arbeit hat eine direkte, messbare Wirkung auf das Leben von Kindern und Jugendlichen.
* **Echte Flexibilität:** Arbeite zu 100 % remote, Teilzeit, mit selbstorganisierten Arbeitszeiten (Kernzeiten am Nachmittag/frühen Abend), die zu deiner Lebensrealität passen.
* **Raum für Gestaltung:** Du entwickelst strategische Recruiting\- und Wachstumsstrukturen aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir viel Freiheit für eigene Ideen und kurze Entscheidungswege.
* **Sinnstiftung \& Team:** Du wirst Teil eines intrinsisch motivierten Teams, das eine ehrliche Feedbackkultur und offene Diskussionen schätzt.
* **Langfristigkeit:** Wir suchen dich für eine dauerhafte Zusammenarbeit – die **Teilzeit**\-**Stelle ist unbefristet.**
* **Faire Konditionen:** Eine Vergütung von **23\.500 € bis 25\.500 € brutto pro Jahr** bei **20 Wochenstunden**.

Uns ist wichtig, dass du dich bei uns wohlfühlst, wachsen kannst und langfristig gerne bleibst. Wir verstehen Arbeit nicht nur als Aufgabenliste, sondern als gemeinsamen Gestaltungsraum. Gerade weil wir wachsen, freuen wir uns über Menschen, die Wissen zugänglich machen, tragfähige Strukturen entwickeln und ihren Verantwortungsbereich langfristig mitgestalten.

**Bewerbung \& Kontakt**

Hast du Lust, Schule zu einem sicheren Ort zu machen und ein Zeichen zu setzen?  
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Weil uns das persönliche Miteinander wichtig ist, bitten wir dich \- wie bei uns im Team üblich \- unseren **Ansprechpartner Marek** direkt zu duzen.

**Sende deine vollständige Bewerbung bitte als eine zusammengefügte PDF (max. 5 MB) spätestens bis zum 30\.09\.2026 mit folgenden Unterlagen per E\-Mail an mitmachen@zeichen\-gegen\-mobbing.de:**

* Ein **Motivationsschreiben**, aus dem hervorgeht, warum du Teil von Zeichen gegen Mobbing e. V. werden möchtest und was dich an der Rolle des:der Strategic Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Ehrena

Recruitment Manager

Een paar maanden geleden hebben wij via Recruitment Masters nog iemand succesvol aan een baan geholpen bij deze organisatie. Inmiddels zijn de Q3-targets ruim voor het einde van het kwartaal behaald, zijn ze op weg naar hun beste jaar ooit en vertrekt het team volgende week weer samen op teamtrip.

Deze recruitmentorganisatie bestaat inmiddels meer dan 15 jaar en werkt voor grote corporates, scale-ups en internationale merken. Ze hebben een sterke naam opgebouwd binnen hun niche en investeren ook veel in het team, met onder andere meerdere gezamenlijke trips en activiteiten per jaar. Nu zoeken ze een Recruitment Manager.

In deze rol stuur je een team van acht consultants aan. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor performance, ontwikkeling, coaching en het creëren van een cultuur waarin mensen eigenaarschap nemen en resultaten behalen. Je bent onderdeel van het leadershipteam en hebt directe invloed op de verdere groei van de organisatie.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing, ontwikkeling en prestaties van een team van acht consultants.

Je coacht consultants op recruitmentvaardigheden, commerciële resultaten en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Je zorgt voor structuur, focus en eigenaarschap binnen het team en bewaakt de voortgang op individuele en gezamenlijke doelstellingen.

Daarnaast leid je teammeetings, performancegesprekken en ontwikkelsessies. Je signaleert verbeterkansen in processen, werkwijzen en samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat deze daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd.

WIE BEN JIJ?

Je hebt ruime ervaring binnen recruitment en bent een natuurlijke leider die al eerder succesvol een team van recruiters, consultants of accountmanagers heeft aangestuurd. Je weet hoe je verschillende persoonlijkheden meekrijgt, spreekt mensen aan wanneer dat nodig is en krijgt energie van het ontwikkelen en laten presteren van een team.

Omdat het kantoor wat lastiger bereikbaar is, woon je bij voorkeur in of rondom het centrum van Amsterdam. Je gaat graag op de fiets naar kantoor 🚲.

WAT KRIJG JE TERUG?

Basissalaris max €85.000 per jaar, ex vakantiegeld ex bonus;
Sleutelpositie binnen een ambitieuze recruitmentorganisatie;
Directe invloed op de prestaties, cultuur en groei van het team;
Onderdeel van het leadershipteam;
Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap;
Diverse incentive trips, teamactiviteiten en ontwikkelmogelijkheden.

INTERVIEWPROCES

Ze schakelen snel.
Telefonische kennismaking met ons.
Eerste gesprek met de directeur.
Tweede gesprek met een aantal mensen van het team.
Arbeidsvoorwaardelijk voorstel.

INTERESSE GEWEKT?

Contact: Neal van de Kamer - eigenaar van Recruitment Masters
E-mail: neal@recruitment-masters.nl
WhatsApp: wa.me/+31626164850
Bellen: +31626164850

OVER DE RECRUITER

Ik ben Neal van de Kamer. 12-voudig Nederlands kampioen judo en auteur van een #1 Amazon Bestseller. Met Recruitment Masters helpen wij bedrijven aan commerciële en recruitment professionals. Ons team bestaat uit voormalig topsporters die dezelfde drive herkennen in kandidaten als onze klanten.

FAQ

Om welk bedrijf gaat het?

Dat bespreken we tijdens de eerste kennismaking. Ik beloof je dat het dan niet zo vaag blijft als deze vacature. We bespreken de naam van het bedrijf, de rol inhoudelijk en het team in de eerste kennismaking.

Ja. Voor deze rol zoeken we iemand die eerder recruiters of consultants heeft aangestuurd en ervaring heeft met coaching, performance management en teamontwikkeling.

Heb ik zelf nog een omzetdoel?

De focus ligt op het succes van het team. Het gaat in deze rol veel meer om leiderschap, ontwikkeling en performance dan om het zelf sluiten van de meeste deals.

jobs.description:
Job Description

At GHD, we don’t just believe in the power of commitment, we live and breathe it every day.

That’s why we pledge to empower all of our people to make a positive impact. Combining our deep technical expertise with the capabilities of our clients and partners, we respond to some of the most complex challenges facing our planet today.

See where your commitment could take you.

Our pledge to you

Join GHD

That’s the #PowerOfCommittment

There’s no pledge more important than the one we make to look after our environment, and we’re committed to helping you do exactly that. 

Join us as we strive to ensure a sustainable future for our communities and the world we live in.

Become part of our global network of skilled engineers, scientists, auditors, planners and environmental specialists, all working together to leave this world better than we found it.

Are you ready to lead a dynamic team of Emergency Response/Preparedness and environmental professionals in tackling some of the most pressing challenges facing our environment today?

 Who are we looking for? 

As a Project Manager at GHD, you will not only mentor and guide the team but also take the reins in environmental emergencies, collaborating closely with clients and agencies to ensure effective response and resolution.

Your role will extend beyond project management to include business development and client expansion activities, where your expertise in environmental engineering, geology, or related fields will shine. With 5+ years of project management experience under your belt, including a proven track record in emergency response, client relationship management, and business development, you'll bring a wealth of knowledge to the table.

From conducting environmental sampling and monitoring to spearheading regional visibility initiatives, your passion for environmental stewardship and problem-solving will drive our success. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess exceptional communication skills, and are committed to making a difference, join us in shaping a sustainable future. Apply today and Join our Emergency Management (GHD FIRST) team.

This opportunity can be based out of the Chicago office.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiting Manager
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

Our ability to identify, hire, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to our mission. The Talent team at TRM is made up of seasoned professionals who have experience hiring world-class Engineering, Data Science, GTM, and People teams for the most notable startups in Silicon Valley.

As Technical Recruiting Manager, you will lead the team responsible for finding and closing some of the hardest-to-source technical talent in the market: engineers, data scientists, security researchers, and applied AI talent who can build at the pace TRM moves. This is not a role for someone who wants to run an existing playbook; it's for someone who wants to build a world-class technical recruiting function and raise the bar on every hire that comes through it.

The Impact You’ll Have Here

Manage and coach a team of technical recruiters, raising the bar on sourcing strategy, candidate experience, and closing excellence.
Oversee delivery of high-priority engineering and technical roles; step in on complex searches as needed.
Partner closely with executives and hiring managers to calibrate, forecast, and course-correct hiring plans.
Build and scale technical recruiting capacity ahead of need: forecast hiring demand across R&D, translate it into your team's staffing plan.
Optimize tools, processes, and systems to drive speed, precision, and data hygiene across the recruiting funnel.
Build a culture of excellence, feedback, and continuous improvement within the recruiting team.

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of technical recruiting experience, including 4+ years managing high growth teams
Proven ability to hire for complex technical roles in high-growth environments
Demonstrated success coaching recruiters and raising execution quality across a team
Strategic thinker with strong instincts for prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and problem-solving
Operationally excellent with experience managing recruiting tools, dashboards, and workflows
Clear, concise communicator comfortable working with execs and distributed teams

About The Team

Our Talent team is fully remote, embracing async collaboration via Slack, documentation, and proactive updates.
We meet weekly for hiring syncs, sourcing jams, and team huddles to support shared momentum and alignment.
The team is known for rigor, humility, and craft obsession—we continuously refine systems and raise our own bar.
Most team members operate with a 4+ hour overlap with PST; we value flexibility and autonomy with accountability.

Preferred

SF Bay Area-based; in office up to 2x per week as needed

Learn About TRM Speed In This Position

Within 72 hours of receiving a new headcount request, the Recruiting Manager ensures an intake meeting is scheduled and reviews sample profiles with recruiters.
Within 48 hours of initial candidate feedback, partners with recruiters to synthesize insights and evolve search strategy; expects A/B tested outreach to be in-market within 24 hours.
Within the first week of launching a new search, team has surfaced and messaged 100+ targeted candidates and flagged key conversion levers by channel or source.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

The estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000-$220,000.
Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.
Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What To Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.
Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.
Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.
Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate
Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more: Interviewing at TRM: How We Hire and What Success Looks Like

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy And Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Job Title

Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition

Department

People Ops: Talent Center of Excellence

Job Level

P4, Exempt

Our Mission

To deliver the expertise, standards, and technology necessary to power growth and scale throughout the philanthropic economy. We are committed to empowering people, ideas, and institutions for good. We promise to take care of the administrative duties that often distract us from meaningful work so our customers and their clients can spend more of their time and attention saving the world. We believe it is our duty to ensure the efficient and effective flow of social capital to the causes that matter the most to donors.

Position Description

The Senior Manager of Talent Acquisition owns the talent acquisition function as a domain — setting standards, driving outcomes, and serving as the authoritative recruiting voice across the organization. In a regulated fintech environment, this role carries a dual mandate: delivering the hiring speed and quality a scaling organization demands, while ensuring that every process — from intake to offer — meets the compliance standards the industry requires.

This role is expected to own how the organization hires: defining the standard for structured interviewing, establishing the recruiting metrics framework, providing market intelligence that informs workforce planning, and personally leading the most complex and critical searches. Operating without direct reports, the P4 designation is anchored in functional authority and cross-functional influence — partnering closely with the Compensation Analyst on offer construction, with HRBPs on workforce planning, and with the VP on headcount forecasting and capacity planning. This role requires senior-level stakeholder management and executive communication: the credibility and composure to deliver market intelligence a senior leader may not want to hear, and the influence to make that conversation productive rather than defensive.

Duties & Responsibilities

Manage a portfolio of open requisitions across assigned business units — engineering, product, compliance, risk, sales, and operations — owning the full-cycle process from job brief through offer acceptance and pre-boarding handoff to onboarding
Conduct structured intake meetings with hiring managers before any sourcing begins: clarify role requirements, competency profiles, level calibration, compensation range, and success criteria — and push back when the brief is unclear, the scope is unrealistic, or the timeline doesn't account for market conditions
Build and execute proactive sourcing strategies for each requisition: LinkedIn, job boards, referral activation, talent community engagement, and direct outreach — with sourcing channel effectiveness tracked and reported monthly
Screen, assess, and advance candidates using structured interview frameworks; facilitate calibrated debrief conversations with hiring teams to ensure bias-mitigated, evidence-based decisions that hold up to scrutiny in a regulated environment
Own candidate experience at every stage: timely, transparent communication, high-quality final-round experiences regardless of outcome, and a post-offer engagement cadence that reduces withdrawal risk between acceptance and start date
Partner with the VP of Talent and the Compensation Analyst on all offer construction: no offer is extended without a compensation review that confirms market alignment, internal equity, and band adherence
Present and close offers with market context — framing the total compensation package relative to what the candidate could expect elsewhere, and managing counter-offer conversations with transparency and discipline
Track offer acceptance rates and withdrawal patterns; surface trends to the VP of Talent that should inform compensation philosophy, offer timing, or candidate experience improvements
Serve as the primary day-to-day talent partner for senior hiring managers across assigned business units: proactively sharing market intelligence, flagging pipeline risk before it becomes a delay, and consulting on role design and team structure when growth plans create new hiring demands
Translate company growth plans into executable hiring roadmaps in partnership with the VP of Talent: role prioritization, sourcing lead times, interview panel configuration, and contingency planning for niche or hard-to-fill positions
Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and the competitive hiring landscape for fintech roles — particularly in engineering, compliance, and risk functions where the talent market is constrained and move quickly
Support workforce planning conversations with HRBPs: contributing recruiter perspective on talent supply, market conditions, and role-level complexity to inform headcount decisions before they become approved requisitions
Leverage AI-powered recruiting tools to enhance sourcing reach, accelerate candidate screening, and improve pipeline efficiency — while applying human judgment to ensure outputs are accurate, bias-aware, and compliant with Ren's standards

Education & Experience

10+ years of talent acquisition experience, with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity across that tenure
2–4+ years owning recruiting processes at a functional level — accountable for process quality, standards design, and hiring outcomes across a portfolio of roles, not just personal search delivery
Demonstrated experience hiring within fintech, SaaS, or regulated financial services environments — with a working understanding of the compliance expectations those environments place on recruiting processes
Track record of managing high-volume and specialized hiring simultaneously: the ability to maintain quality on complex niche searches without allowing the broader pipeline to degrade is a specific competency this role requires
Experience scaling recruiting processes in organizations between 300–1,000+ employees, where the informal practices that worked at 150 are being replaced by structured, repeatable systems
Structured interviewing design and facilitation: this role must be able to teach it, assess it, and hold others accountable for applying it consistently
DEI best practices in talent acquisition: inclusive sourcing, bias mitigation in assessment, and diverse slate construction — applied as standard practice, not activated only for high-visibility searches
Recruiting analytics: the ability to build and maintain a metrics framework, read it accurately, and use it to make process decisions rather than justify existing practices
Compensation fluency: enough market knowledge to participate meaningfully in offer conversations with the Compensation Analyst and to advise hiring managers on candidate positioning before the offer stage
ATS proficiency and a systems orientation: the instinct to look for technology solutions when manual processes create scale problems, and the discipline to use the system correctly so that data is trustworthy
AI fluency: baseline familiarity with AI-powered recruiting tools — such as sourcing assistants, resume screening platforms, and candidate engagement automation — and the judgment to use them responsibly, critically evaluate their outputs, and identify where human review is required

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Team Overview

Talent Acquisition is how Deepgram's gets built. Our ability to move quickly in voice AI depends on bringing in exceptional people at the pace the business needs.

You’ll lead a team of recruiters and own the day-to-day execution of recruiting across the company. You’ll partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers across engineering, research, and go-to-market to set priorities, build strong pipelines, and make sure the team is delivering against the roles that matter most.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll coach the team, remove blockers, improve how we operate, and step into searches.

What you'll get to do:

Manages a recruiting team — sets priorities, manages capacity, coaches performance, and holds the team accountable for outcomes
Runs full-cycle recruiting — can personally step into sourcing, interviewing, closing, and complex searches when needed
Operates AI-native — builds Human+AI workflows into sourcing, screening, research, and pipeline operations rather than treating AI as an add-on
Builds scalable recruiting systems — identifies recurring work and creates processes, automation, and tooling that eliminate it
Uses data to diagnose problems — understands funnel health, capacity, and conversion, and gets to the root cause rather than adding more process
Develops people — gives direct feedback, creates clear expectations, supports career growth, and raises the capability of the team
Raises the quality of hiring — coaches hiring managers on structured interviewing, drives strong decision-making, and is comfortable challenging senior stakeholders

What you bring:

Typically 5–8 years of recruiting experience, including experience leading or managing recruiters, or equivalent demonstrated experience
Experience hiring across technical and go-to-market functions in a high-growth technology or AI company
Experience recruiting for engineering and/or research roles
Hands-on experience with modern recruiting tools such as Ashby, Metaview, and Juicebox
Has built AI-assisted recruiting workflows or automation that meaningfully improved how a recruiting team operates

We handle all infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and administrative operations so physicians can focus on patient care. Our model gives patients access to the newest therapies while maintaining the trusted patient-physician relationship.

Our Mission:
Improving lives by providing advanced therapeutic options

Our Vision:
Creating the absolute best patient-physician experience in clinical research

Our Values:

Compassion: We prioritize the patient-physician relationship, ensuring every interaction is service-oriented and patient-centered
Urgency: We work hard and practice selflessness, acting swiftly and decisively to meet the needs of our patients, partners, and colleagues
Solution Orientation: We embrace challenges with a positive mindset, communicate directly, and identify and implement effective solutions with efficiency
Excellence: We insist on excellence, holding ourselves accountable and empowering each other to deliver best-in-class service while maintaining the highest ethical and scientific standards

Why This Role Exists

The Talent Acquisition Manager owns how we attract, assess, and hire talent across Profound. As Profound Research grows, our ability to consistently attract and hire exceptional people will be critical to building strong teams and delivering on our mission. This is a hands-on builder role for someone who is as comfortable recruiting great people as they are improving the systems and practices behind the work.

You will partner closely with leaders by understanding what their teams need, bringing perspective on the talent market, and helping them make thoughtful hiring decisions. At the same time, you will continue building a talent acquisition function that can grow with the organization, creating the right amount of structure, developing stronger talent pipelines, and finding better ways to work as our needs evolve.

This role is a strong fit for someone who sees talent acquisition as more than filling open positions. You are curious about what makes an organization successful, willing to challenge an approach that is not working, and energized by the opportunity to build while you execute.

What You’ll Do

Build a Scalable Talent Acquisition Function

Own and continuously improve Profound’s talent acquisition approach, creating practical systems and processes that support quality, consistency, and growth without unnecessary complexity
Anticipate how recruiting needs will evolve as the organization grows and build the infrastructure, tools, and practices needed to support that growth
Evaluate and improve how we use recruiting technology, external partners, sourcing support, and other resources to create an effective and flexible TA model

Recruit Exceptional Talent

Lead full-cycle recruiting across the organization, adapting sourcing and recruiting strategies based on the role, talent market, and business need
Build strong talent pipelines for recurring, difficult-to-fill, and strategically important roles while remaining hands-on in sourcing, assessment, and candidate engagement
Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience that reflects Profound’s culture, values, and expectations while maintaining appropriate urgency and a high bar for talent

Partner With Leaders to Make Better Hiring Decisions

Serve as a trusted talent advisor to hiring managers, helping them define what success requires and translate business needs into effective recruiting strategies
Bring external market perspective, challenge assumptions when needed, and help leaders make thoughtful decisions about candidate profiles, assessment, and selection
Strengthen hiring capability across Profound by creating clear expectations and giving managers the coaching, tools, and support they need to hire well

Use Talent Insights to Drive Better Outcomes

Maintain a clear view of current and anticipated hiring demand, recruiting capacity, and talent-market conditions so risks and constraints can be addressed early
Use meaningful recruiting data and patterns to understand what is working, diagnose challenges, and recommend changes that improve hiring outcomes
Make thoughtful recommendations about where internal resources, sourcing support, agencies, or other flexible capacity will create the greatest value

Essential Qualifications

What You Bring

6+ years of progressive talent acquisition experience, with strong full-cycle recruiting capabilities across sourcing, candidate assessment, hiring manager partnership, and closing candidates across a variety of roles
Experience helping build, improve, or scale talent acquisition practices in a growing organization, rather than only operating within established recruiting systems
Strong business judgment and the ability to translate a leader’s hiring need into a thoughtful recruiting strategy, including the confidence to challenge assumptions and recommend a different approach when needed
A builder mindset with the ability to identify what is not working, develop practical solutions, and create enough structure to help the organization scale without adding unnecessary complexity
Comfort operating in a fast-changing environment, shifting priorities when needed while maintaining ownership, follow through, and a high standard for the work
Strong communication and relationship building skills, with the ability to earn trust with candidates and leaders while being clear, candid, and solutions oriented

Preferred Qualifications

Experience recruiting in a multi-site, geographically distributed, or operationally complex organization
Experience supporting an organization through meaningful growth or another significant scaling period
Experience in clinical research, healthcare, life sciences, biotechnology, or another regulated industry
Experience using recruiting data, technology, talent pipelines, and flexible recruiting resources to improve how a talent acquisition function operates

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

This role is primarily performed in a remote/office environment and requires prolonged periods of sitting or standing at a desk, working on a computer, and participating in virtual meetings
Requires the ability to communicate clearly in verbal and written forms and to read and interpret detailed materials
Minimal travel to company sites, meetings, or partner locations may be required, including the ability to navigate office/clinical environments and transport typical work materials
Must be able to maintain a productive and professional remote work setup with reliable internet connectivity
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role

Why Join Profound Research?

Meaningful Impact: Every role at Profound contributes to advancing medical knowledge and expanding therapeutic options for patients - the work we do here matters
Professional Growth: We invest in our people through comprehensive training, certification support, and ongoing education to help you grow in your role and your career

jobs.description:
SUMMARY

Position: Talent Acquisition Manager at Holding Company Modeled After Berkshire Hathaway 
Client Name: Tucker’s Farm 
Company’s Website: www.tuckersfarm.com 
Location: Fully remote 
Start Date: Immediately  
Annual Compensation (Details below) 
Base salary: $100,000
Bonus: $20,000 + (based on completed recruitments) 

BACKGROUND

We are a low-profile, value-oriented holding vehicle modeled after Berkshire Hathaway. The founders/investment team is comprised of value investors from Apollo Global Management (~$80bn private equity group) and Viking Global Investors (~$50bn hedge fund). We have various portfolio companies or ‘platforms’ (also known as rollups, aggregations, or buy-and-builds). Each platform is capitalized with a long-term equity base and has the sole mandate of compounding cash flows for the long term, primarily through M&A. We have a broad mandate and look for opportunities across industries, geographies and the capital structure, although our primary focus is on rollups. 

We are seeking a full-time Talent Acquisition Manager to help scale our recruiting function — establishing processes, sourcing channels, and hiring velocity across both our corporate team and our growing portfolio of companies. You'll partner directly with the COO and portfolio company CEOs to understand hiring needs and translate them into a reliable, high-quality talent pipeline.  

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

An initial preview of the responsibilities & tasks are as follows (there will be more, but this will give you a general sense of the roles & responsibilities): 
Build and manage end-to-end recruiting for all roles — Private Equity (investment professionals, business development associates, research analysts), portfolio company (CEO, CFO, COO, SVP of Finance, Head of BD)  
Design and implement a scalable hiring process: intake, sourcing, screening, interview structure, offer, and onboarding handoff 
Manage our ATS and establish consistent data hygiene, reporting, and pipeline visibility for leadership 
Build Tucker’s Farm's employer brand — careers page, social presence, candidate experience 
Own time-to-fill, offer acceptance rate, quality of hire, and sourcing channel ROI as core KPIs 

IMPORTANT NOTE

At Tucker’s Farm, we hire for attributes and potential over specific experience or formal education. We’re looking for hungry, go-getter individuals who are excellent on the phone and have a drive to succeed in a career in finance & investing. Your experience could vary widely, and we encourage applications from diverse backgrounds. 

KEY ATTRIBUTES WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Excellent verbal communication skills 
Hunger and drive to succeed in a fast-paced environment 
Ability to thrive without extensive structure 
Strong project management skills (i.e., superb at to-do-lists, meticulous execution managing multiple workstreams and correspondence with brokers) 
Highly organized, exceptional attention to detail, and solutions-oriented 
Comfort with performance-based compensation 

YOUR BACKGROUND MIGHT LOOK LIKE

5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience; at least 2 years in private equity, finance, and operations 
Demonstrated ability to build recruiting infrastructure, not just fill requisitions 
Strong sourcing instincts — Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, and niche job boards are second nature 
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, PE-backed growth environment with evolving priorities and lean structure 
Data-driven mindset — you track everything and use metrics to improve process, not just report activity 
Strong communicator and relationship builder; you earn trust quickly with hiring managers and candidates alike 

COMPENSATION STRUCTURE 

Base salary of $100,000
Bonus of up to $20,000+, depending on performance 
$5,000 bonus paid per signed offer letter 

NEXT STEP

Please submit your resume and a 3-5 minute video (consisting of a personal introduction and why you’d be a good fit for the job) to hiring@tuckersfarm.com to be considered.

Jij zorgt dat hun contracten kloppen, dat hun gegevens in AFAS actueel zijn en dat de salarisverwerking op tijd de deur uit gaat. Jouw taken:

Je stelt contracten en wijzigingen op en verwerkt ze.
De HR-mailbox beheer je en de meeste vragen van collega's en leidinggevenden beantwoord je zelf.
Je bereidt de maandelijkse salarisverwerking mee voor en controleert de mutaties.
In AFAS houd je de personeelsgegevens actueel en je ziet fouten voordat iemand er last van heeft.
De standaard HR-rapportages maak jij.
Terugkerend handwerk spoor je op en je komt met een voorstel om het te automatiseren.
Bij een overname help je mee om nieuwe collega's administratief netjes aan boord te krijgen.

Over ons

Bij Health Cloud Initiative (HCI) werken ruim 230 collega's aan één doel: betere zorg, makkelijk geregeld. Vanuit HCI werk je aan zorgsoftware die het werk van zorgprofessionals makkelijker maakt: meer overzicht, minder handelingen en meer tijd voor de patiënt. Jij zorgt dat de mensen die dat bouwen zich geen zorgen hoeven te maken over hun contract of hun salaris.
Je komt in een klein HR-team met business partners, een collega op HR Operations en recruitment. Met die collega werk je nauw samen, onder meer omdat we de salarisverwerking altijd met vier ogen controleren. De sfeer is nuchter en direct. Vragen stellen mag altijd en niemand kijkt raar op als je iets nog niet weet. Je rapporteert aan de HR Director, die je ruimte geeft om zelf verbeteringen door te voeren en meekijkt zodra iets ingewikkeld wordt. Bij HCI gebeurt genoeg, dus wie kansen ziet om iets slimmer te doen verveelt zich hier niet.

Wat bieden we jou?

Bij Health Cloud Initiative geloven we in zorg voor elkaar, ook binnen het team. Daarom bieden wij jou:
Een passend salaris bij jouw ervaring in de range tussen € 3.125,00 - € 4.464,00.
25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 10 extra dagen bij te kopen.
Een pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding.
Veel vrijheid om je werkdag zelf in te delen, hybride werken is bij ons vanzelfsprekend.
Thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 per dag.
Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 500,- per twee jaar.
Je krijgt ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Een plek waar je niet alleen komt halen, maar ook mag brengen. Jouw ideeën doen ertoe.
Een fijne werkplek met dagelijks vers fruit en gezellige tafelgenoten aan de gezamenlijke lunch op locatie.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je werkt nauwkeurig en je vindt het vervelend als er een fout in de gegevens sluipt. Loopt iets vast, dan vraag je op tijd hulp. En je bent nieuwsgierig naar wat AI en slimme tools voor je kunnen doen, want daar zit een flink deel van het plezier in deze baan.
Hbo werk- en denkniveau, richting HRM, P&O of bedrijfskunde.
Twee tot drie jaar ervaring in HR-administratie.
Je hebt meegedraaid in de salarisverwerking.
Handig met digitale tools en echt geïnteresseerd in AI en automatisering.
Ervaring met AFAS is mooi meegenomen, een eis is het niet.

Interesse?

We bekijken je sollicitatie zorgvuldig. Sluit je ervaring aan, dan ga je kennismaken met onze recruiter.

jobs.description:
Als HR Business Partner bij HCI Paramedie ben jij de HR-expert waar de directeur van de business unit en de leidinggevenden mee sparren. Je zit dicht op de praktijk: bij het gesprek dat een manager liever uitstelt, en bij de verandering die eraan komt. Er verandert het nodige bij Paramedie, en jij staat middenin die beweging. Jij zorgt dat mensen snappen waarom, en dat het netjes gaat.

Wat ga je doen?

HCI Paramedie maakt software voor fysiotherapeuten en andere paramedici. Hoe soepeler het hier loopt, hoe beter die software wordt en hoe minder administratie een behandelaar overhoudt. Jouw doel is een gezonde business unit: de juiste mensen op de juiste plek en leidinggevenden die hun werk aankunnen.

Je adviseert de directeur van de business unit en de leidinggevenden over alles wat met mensen en organisatie te maken heeft.

De jaarlijkse performancecyclus draai jij voor de business unit en je bewaakt de kwaliteit ervan.

Komt er een kantoor bij, dan help je dat op HR-gebied aansluiten op de rest van HCI.

Bij Health Cloud Initiative (HCI) werken ruim 230 collega's aan één doel: betere zorg, makkelijk geregeld. jobs.description:
**Talent Acquisition Lead**  

  

**From Operations to Oracle, Sales to SAP, Marketing to PeopleSoft \- help us find exceptional talent globally and build brilliant teams!**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  

  

**About the role:**  

  

At Support Revolution, great people drive our success, and we're looking for someone who loves finding them!  

  

We're looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Lead to find and attract brilliant talent across the UK, USA, India and beyond, supporting our continued growth in the Oracle, SAP and PeopleSoft third\-party support market.  

  

You'll be hands\-on with recruitment while leading and supporting our internal recruitment team, headhunting great candidates, building talent pipelines, benchmarking the market and partnering with hiring managers across the business.  

  

If you love the buzz of finding the perfect candidate, enjoy making recruitment better and are ready to take the lead, we'd love to hear from you!  

  

This full\-time position is fully remote within the UK.
  

  

**What you’ll be doing:**  

  

Here’s where you’ll make your mark:

  

* Lead and develop our Talent Acquisition function, setting high standards for recruitment quality and candidate experience
* Personally deliver end\-to\-end recruitment across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance and other corporate functions
* Lead recruitment for senior, specialist and business\-critical appointments
* Use direct sourcing, headhunting and talent mapping to identify exceptional candidates in competitive markets
* Build and maintain talent pipelines aligned to future business growth
* Provide salary benchmarking, competitor intelligence and talent\-market insight to support hiring decisions
* Review recruitment campaigns, sourcing strategies, job adverts and candidate shortlists to ensure consistently high standards
* Coach and support our internal recruiting team, sharing expertise and driving recruitment excellence across the team
* Partner with hiring managers to define roles, candidate profiles and effective selection strategies
* Develop our employer proposition and ensure our external recruitment presence reflects the Support Revolution brand.

You’ll bring:

  

* Significant end\-to\-end in\-house Talent Acquisition experience
* A strong track record recruiting across commercial and corporate functions, such as Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance
* Excellent direct sourcing and headhunting capability
* Strong knowledge of salary benchmarking, talent mapping and market intelligence
* Experience building proactive candidate pipelines
* The credibility and confidence to partner with senior stakeholders
* Experience coaching, mentoring or providing professional leadership to other recruiters
* Excellent judgement when assessing candidate quality and suitability
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how talent strategy supports business growth
* The ability to operate successfully across different functions, seniority levels and international markets


Oracle, SAP or PeopleSoft recruitment experience? Even better, but it’s not a deal breaker!  

  

**Interview process:**  

  

Our hiring process is designed to be efficient and transparent. Here’s what to expect:

* **Screening Call** – A friendly chat with our Talent Acquisition team to get to know you and discuss the role
* **Hiring Manager Interview** – Your chance to showcase your skills, experience, and ask us any questions about the role and team
* **Team Interview** **–** Get to meet with other team members, dive into the exciting projects you’ll be working on, and experience the collaborative energy that drives our success!
* **Final HR Interview** – A deeper conversation to understand your values, ensure a great cultural fit, and discuss the next steps.

 **Benefits and perks:**  

  

We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* **Competitive Salary:** We value your hard work with a competitive package to be discussed from the very first conversation
* **Generous Annual Leave:** Take plenty of time to recharge with 25 days holiday, plus UK Bank Holidays, plus extra days as you grow with us!
* **Annual Leave Purchase Scheme:** Need more time to relax? Purchase up to 5 additional days' leave per annum
* **Birthday Leave:** Your birthday is yours – take the day off and enjoy it your way
* **Length of Service Rewards:** Enjoy rewards like bonuses, extra leave, and paid sabbaticals for your dedication
* **Company Pension Scheme:** Secure your future with our Company pension scheme
* **Perkbox Perks:** Treat yourself with discounts, cashback, and wellness benefits
* **Fully Remote Model:** Enjoy the flexibility of working 100% remotely, from wherever you are in the UK \- no office required!
* **Employee Wellbeing:** We’ve got your back with EAP, eye tests, flu vouchers, and excellent sick pay if you’re ever unwell
* **Personal Development:** We invest in you with tailored training and career growth
* **Employee Referral Scheme:** Get rewarded for bringing great talent to our team.

  

**About Support Revolution:**  

  

At Support Revolution, we help organisations break free from overpriced software support and forced upgrades, slashing maintenance costs while delivering superior service. Our mission is to empower businesses to reallocate savings into innovation, fuelling their growth.
  

If you’re ready to be part of a fast\-growing, forward\-thinking company, join us and be part of the revolution!

As a key member of the International HR team, the successful candidate will work closely with the Executive Director, International HR Business Partner to develop and execute people strategies that support business growth while aligning with global priorities and local market needs.

Self-starter mentality who feels comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description:
American Directions Research Group is hiring a Human Resources Manager to run the HR function for a national survey research firm with a 100 percent US-based team and nearly four decades in the field.
This is a hands-on role and a standalone function without direct reports. The recurring work is its foundation: payroll processing, benefits enrollment, onboarding, and offboarding. These are the processes employees feel most directly, and running them accurately and on time is valued here.
There is also real room in the role. We have no legacy HR bureaucracy and no fixed playbook, so someone who wants to improve policy, process, and compensation practice will find both the latitude and the support to do it. We are looking for an experienced generalist who is strong on execution and interested in building. We mention the balance between the two so that whoever joins us arrives with an accurate picture of the work.

What to Expect

Hands-on by design.
Payroll cycles, benefits enrollment, onboarding, offboarding, records, and leave administration are the steady rhythm of the role. This is work you will do yourself, and doing it well is what the company relies on.
Direct line to leadership.
You report to the CEO. Decisions do not travel through layers, and you will get answers quickly.
Full ownership.
Payroll, benefits, recruiting, compliance, employee relations, and compensation all sit with you. You will see the whole employee lifecycle rather than one slice of it.
Complexity worth solving.
We operate a distributed workforce across multiple states, including call center sites and a mix of salaried exempt and hourly non-exempt staff. The compliance and process work is real, and doing it well matters.
A remote culture that already works.
We have operated remote-first for years. The tools, the norms, and the management habits are already in place.
Room to build.
There is no HR department to inherit and no established playbook. Ideas that improve how we operate get a hearing, and the ones that hold up get implemented.
A stable company behind you.
We have been in business for nearly four decades and we are privately held. The company is steady, and the role is not contingent on a funding cycle.

What You Will Do

Payroll, Benefits, and Records

Manage the end-to-end payroll process for salaried exempt and hourly non-exempt employees.
Administer employee benefits programs and serve as the first point of contact for benefits questions.
Maintain accurate and current employee records, including personal information, employment agreements, performance history, and benefits elections.
Manage leave requests, time off, and attendance records.
Manage offboarding, including final pay, benefits termination, and exit documentation.

Talent and Employee Experience

Partner with company leadership to recruit and develop talent across the organization.
Manage the recruiting and onboarding process, including new hire orientation and enrollment paperwork.
Coordinate with call center site personnel who handle portions of local HR administration. These individuals do not report to this position.
Support performance management, employee relations, and conflict resolution.
Provide day-to-day HR support to employees and address concerns directly.

Compliance and Policy

Own HR policies and procedures and ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local law, including EEO, FMLA, and FLSA.
Maintain current knowledge of legal requirements affecting day-to-day management of employees and act to reduce legal risk.
Advise line managers on the application of HR programs within their departments.

Compensation and Program Improvement

These responsibilities build on the recurring work above.
Administer salary and compensation programs, including benchmarking and analysis, and maintain fairness and equity across the organization.
Identify and lead improvements to HR policy, process, and documentation where you see the opportunity.
Take on additional responsibilities as designated by the CEO.

What We Are Looking For

Required

Minimum of five years of progressive, hands-on HR experience.
Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration, or a related field.
Working command of HR principles, practices, and employment law.
Direct experience running payroll and administering benefits.
Experience working in a remote culture.
Familiarity with HRIS, payroll platforms, and database systems.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the judgment to handle sensitive matters with discretion.

Preferred

SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification.
Experience supporting a multi-state, multi-site workforce that includes hourly non-exempt staff.
Prior experience as the sole or senior HR practitioner in an organization.
Experience supporting call center or other high-turnover hourly operations.
Experience selecting or implementing an HRIS or payroll platform.
Interest in building out HR policy, process, and compensation practice alongside the administrative workload.

How You Work

You are comfortable being hands-on and doing the work yourself.
You work effectively with people who do not report to you.
You are accurate and consistent with recurring work, including at volume.
You are organized and process-minded, and you treat improving a process as part of running it.

Role Details

Status:
Regular full-time, exempt salaried, 40 hours per week. Additional hours or flexible scheduling may be required to meet company objectives.
Location:
Fully remote within the United States. A hybrid arrangement is available for candidates near Washington, DC or Lakeland, FL.
Physical requirements:
Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary:
$82,000 to $90,000 per year.
Bonus:
Discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance.
Benefits:
Medical, dental, and vision coverage; life insurance; 401(k) with company matching; paid time off; and paid holidays.

Starting compensation will be determined at the time of offer and will depend on skill set, relevant experience, education, and other professional credentials.

About American Directions Research Group

For nearly four decades, American Directions Research Group has guided businesses, organizations, research consultancies, and policymakers toward truly representative insights. We specialize in professional data collection: sophisticated CATI, online, text-to-web, and in-language surveys administered by skilled interviewers, supported by a secure survey platform and concierge-level project management.
We are privately held and have conducted more than 63 million interviews with a team based entirely in the United States. We are headquartered in Washington, DC with national offices.

When it comes to survey research, We Know America.

American Directions Research Group is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
