jobs.title: Head of People Operations
jobs.description:
The Patrick J. McGovern Foundation (PJMF) is a $1.5 billion philanthropy working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, data science, and the public interest. This role exists to make sure the team advancing our mission is supported, developed, and set up to do the best work of their careers.

The Head of People Operations reports to the VP, People and Culture, and leads several critical pillars of the P&C function: manager capability, performance culture, organizational and manager learning, technical and non-technical recruiting, employee relations, HR compliance, and benefits.

This is a role for someone who excels at both strategic people conversations and being in the weeds of an employee relations matter. You bring sound judgment to hard situations. You build teams and systems that hold up over time. You care about the mission, and that care shows up in how you treat your colleagues every day.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Employee Relations: Lead employee relations responsibilities and serve as a primary point of contact for employee questions, concerns, and policy interpretation. Independently handle employee relations matters, including advising managers on performance and conduct issues and resolving workplace concerns with limited oversight. Document issues and processes with precision. Exercise judgment in identifying and escalating highly complex or high-risk matters to the VP and outside counsel with a clear written record.
Manager Coaching and Development: Design and run a manager coaching curriculum for people managers across all functions. Coach managers through employee relations situations: performance concerns, difficult conversations, team dynamics, and conflict resolution. Maintain and refine a manager toolkit to reduce reliance on P&C for routine people-related decisions. Identify capability gaps across the management layer and build targeted development responses.
Talent Acquisition: Lead full-cycle recruiting for technical and non-leadership roles, including sourcing, screening, interview design, and offer coordination. Manage the ATS and ensure a consistent, well-documented candidate experience. Develop interview frameworks tied to PJMF's competency model. Support the VP on senior searches.
Performance Management: Own the annual and mid-year review cycle end-to-end: system launch, communication, calibration preparation, timeline management, and quality review. Maintain and improve our performance management infrastructure on our 3rd party platform. Support managers in writing evidence-based assessments. Flag patterns across team ratings and bring a calibration perspective to the VP.
Learning and Development: Build an annual L&D calendar aligned to organizational competency needs. Design onboarding that accelerates time-to-contribution for new hires. Source and manage external facilitators and vendors for specific programs or organizational needs.
HR Operations and Compliance: Own day-to-day HR operations: new hire setup, offboarding, employment verifications, and status changes. Administer benefits in partnership with our PEO. Maintain compliance with federal and multi-state employment law requirements for a remote workforce. Manage record retention and I-9 compliance. Maintain HRIS accuracy and serve as the primary system administrator for all people systems.

What We Are Looking For

10 or more years in HR, with at least 7 years in roles focused on employee relations, manager development and coaching, or talent management. Technical recruiting experience required. Experience managing a team is preferred.
Demonstrated experience coaching managers through performance and conduct situations effectively.
Deep working knowledge across core HR disciplines: employee relations, talent development, performance management, full-cycle recruitment, compensation and benefits, and multi-state employment law.
Experience designing and delivering effective learning programs that drive behavior change. Demonstrated ability to deliver coaching conversations and group facilitation sessions for managers at all levels. You can build a persuasive argument verbally and in writing. Stakeholders leave your sessions clear on what matters and what to do next.
Hands-on experience with Google Workspace, Asana, Culture Amp, or a comparable performance platform, an ATS, and LinkedIn Recruiter. Demonstrated use of AI tools in an HR context, with enough working knowledge to evaluate new tools, spot limitations, and advise the team on practical applications.
Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms, benefits administration, and multi-state compliance in a remote workforce.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience. HR certification is strongly preferred.

Skills And Competencies

Communication and influence. You read the room and adjust. With a skeptical manager, you are direct and concrete. With senior leadership, you lead with the implication. Your documentation stands on its own. Managers come to you before situations escalate because your advice works.
Sound judgment. You know when a decision is not yours to make alone, and you say so clearly. You are analytical when data is available and decisive when it is not. You see trends in people data and name them to leadership without being asked.
Execution. You bring structure to ambiguous work. You take a program from concept to rollout and track what is working without being prompted. When you own something, it gets done.
Process and people in balance. You hold the line on process without losing sight of the person in front of you. You are consistent without being rigid.
Equity in practice. You have changed a hiring, performance, or development outcome through this lens. You can point to the specific decision you made differently and what happened as a result.
AI fluency. You have used AI tools in HR work, whether in recruiting, performance, or people analytics. You understand where these tools add value and where human judgment cannot be replaced. You can help the team think through adoption decisions with that context in hand.
Comfort with start-up-like environments. You have worked in a place where strategic and administrative work land in the same space. You treat operational tasks with equal urgency as larger initiatives. You understand that credibility at this scale is built through consistent execution.
Remote-first effectiveness. You thrive in a 100% remote environment and can build connections to work and people without having to share physical space. You communicate proactively in writing. You build relationships without relying on proximity. You stay visible without being performative.
Work eligibility: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. (No visa sponsorship available)

What We Offer

The salary range for this is $130,000-$150,000.
Starting salaries are typically placed in the lower half of the range, with flexibility based on the experience you bring. Beyond career-defining work, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support you along the way:

Health Coverage - Foundation-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees, spouses/domestic partners, and dependents. Coverage includes family planning support, a One Medical subscription, and begins on the date of hire.
Employer-paid group term life insurance and short-term and long-term disability insurance.
Long-term Rewards - 401(k) retirement plan with generous matching up to 6% of annual pay, plus an additional discretionary match at the end of the year.
PTO & Leave Options - Paid time off, which allows team members to take the time they need for vacation, illness, volunteer time, bereavement, medical leave, so they can return to work able to contribute fully to our mission. The foundation recognizes 11 paid national holidays per year and also hosts a winter break at the end of the year.
Parental Leave - Up to 6 months of gender-neutral paid leave for parents and caregivers when they have a new addition to their families
Remote Work Environment - Ability to work 100% remotely within the USA, but not alone, with mature, socially minded professionals. Annual all staff summit in the Summer. Remote work stipend to support remote working needs.
Wellness Support - Employee Assistance Programs, access to Ginger, Headspace, and SmartSpend Plus, along with financial well-being providers
Learning Reimbursements - Foundation policy encouraging employees to explore development opportunities such as peer learning, internal training, and external activities; savings on student loans (available via insurance provider)
Philanthropic Gift Matching - opportunity for team members to support nonprofits in their community, reflecting PJMF’s commitment to social impact

All application questions are required. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

PJMF is committed to fair and transparent compensation practices. Our salary ranges are informed by market data from peer organizations in our sector. Our salaries are competitive and equitable, and they align with peers in the same job group. Because salary ranges are small and the internal parity review is thorough, offers are firm.

Ever wondered what it's like to shape the employee experience at a company that's internationally scaling? At ComplianceWise, you won't just support HR, you'll own it, end to end.

We're a fast-growing SaaS scale-up building AML compliance technology that's redefining how organizations stay compliant. Our platform, Grub, helps over 600 organizations stay on the right side of Dutch financial crime regulations, and we're just getting started. We're based in Amsterdam and expanding across Europe.
We're open, international, and refreshingly non-hierarchical. Trust, collaboration, and a healthy dose of humour are baked into how we work, because we believe work should be challenging, rewarding, and genuinely enjoyable. Our values
: we succeed as a team, we make things happen, we launch and learn, and we embrace honesty

+ About the role

People are at the heart of how we build this company, and we're looking for someone who actually believes that. As our People Business Partner, you'll operationally own the full employee experience, from the moment someone says yes to the offer, to the day they leave. You are the person employees feel comfortable coming to before things become a bigger deal. You will work closely with the leadership and report to the COO.

+ What you’ll do

Recruitment & onboarding

Own the full hiring process from job posting to offer to first day
Build our employer brand and attract people who'll genuinely thrive here
Make sure new joiners feel set up for success, and that offboarding is handled with the same care

Talent & development

Run reviews, feedback cycles, and coaching conversations
Own our L&D program and help people grow in the right direction for them
Partner with managers on team dynamics and where their people want to grow

People ops & compliance

Manage payroll, benefits, compensation reviews, and HR tooling, keep the engine run smoothly
Handle documentation, contracts, and legal requirements, including as we expand internationally
Keep our HR systems and processes tidy and up to date

Culture & employee experience

Keep a real pulse on how people are feeling and turn that into action
Organize moments that bring the team together, not just events for the sake of it
Own other people moments: birthdays, anniversaries etc and the office experience
Support wellbeing and make sure people feel genuinely heard
Contribute to how we think about people as we grow

+ What you bring

HR experience, ideally across both recruitment and people operations, you're comfortable owning the process, not just supporting it.
Strong people instincts: genuine empathy, real discretion, and the ability to have honest conversations when they're needed
A proactive mindset: you notice things before they become problems and take ownership without being asked
Sharp organizational skills and solid follow-through: people can count on you to get things done
Comfort with a degree of ambiguity: you can pick up context quickly, figure out what matters most, and keep moving

+ What you get

Competitive salary
Growth opportunity to become the trusted strategic partner of the leadership team
25 vacation days, plus the option to take 2 additional weeks of unpaid leave per year
Hybrid working: up to 2 days per week from home, and up to 2 weeks per year working remotely abroad
Special leaves including D&I day off, volunteering day off, and moving day off.
Option to take a sabbatical upon reaching milestones.
OpenUp subscription for mental wellbeing
Public transport reimbursement
An organization that truly invests in your personal and professional development
Multiple ways to connect as a team, including team events, shared lunches, and optional Thursday drinks (DoMiBo)
We value flexibility, work-life balance, and family-friendly policies to help you thrive both professionally and personally.
A bright office in Amsterdam overlooking the Olympic Stadium

+ Inclusivity & Equal Opportunities

At ComplianceWise, we strive for an inclusive work environment where everyone feels welcome and valued. We encourage everyone to apply. Do you have a disability or need accommodations during the application process? Email us at recruiting@compliance-wise.com with your name, the role you are applying for, and your request. We are happy to help.

+ How to Apply

Excited about this role and think you’re a great fit? Apply by sending your CV to recruiting@compliance-wise.com . Note: You must be authorized to work within the EU for this role

jobs.title: HR Manager EY-Parthenon
jobs.description:
Zeker van je impact vandaag. Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen.

Bij EY weet je zeker dat je het verschil maakt: voor je klant, de samenleving, je collega én je eigen ontwikkeling. Tegelijk krijg je de vrijheid om te werken op een manier die bij jouw leven past. Of je nu kiest voor verdieping, verbreding of leiderschap: jij hebt de regie. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s in een open en vertrouwde cultuur ga je elke dag voor het hoogst haalbare. Groot in mogelijkheden, vriendelijk in samenwerking. EY zorgt voor de middelen die je nodig hebt je carrière verder vorm te geven en impact te maken binnen jouw vakgebied.

Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Als HR Manager EY-Parthenon vervul je een uitdagende en veelzijdige HR -rol binnen één van de meest dynamische onderdelen van EY. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de HR-ondersteuning van EY-Parthenon, de strategie- en transactiepraktijk van EY, en werkt samen met leidinggevenden, partners en de Talent Leader aan het realiseren van onze ambitie: Let's empower people to become Exceptional You.
Door de combinatie van strategische vraagstukken, directe samenwerking met partners en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief is dit een uitstekende rol voor een HR-professional die impact wil maken binnen een snelgroeiende en ambitieuze organisatie.
Dit is een rol met veel verantwoordelijkheid, zichtbaarheid en ondernemerschap. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig te opereren, HR-beleid te vertalen naar de praktijk en actief mee te denken over de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

In deze rol:
Ben je de sparringpartner voor business leaders en de Talent Leader op uiteenlopende HR-thema's, zoals performance management, workforce planning, talentontwikkeling, mobiliteit, verzuim, verloop en beloningsvraagstukken.
Adviseer je over zowel operationele als tactische HR-vraagstukken binnen een ambitieuze en snelgroeiende praktijk.
Speel je een belangrijke rol in de uitvoering van de volledige employee lifecycle, waaronder beoordelingsrondes, promoties, salarisvoorstellen, ontwikkelingstrajecten en mobiliteitsvraagstukken.
Begeleid je organisatieveranderingen en ondersteun je leidinggevenden bij complexe HR-cases en verandertrajecten.
Analyseer je HR-data en managementinformatie en vertaal je inzichten naar concrete acties en adviezen voor de business.
Draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten binnen EY en EY-Parthenon, gericht op het versterken van de employee experience en het realiseren van organisatiedoelstellingen.
Signaleer je kansen voor verbetering en neem je initiatief om HR-processen verder te optimaliseren.
Schakel je moeiteloos tussen dagelijkse HR-uitdagingen en strategische vraagstukken die bijdragen aan de verdere groei van EY-Parthenon.
Bouw je sterke relaties op met stakeholders binnen de business en werk je nauw samen met collega's uit het landelijke HR-team.

Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega's en het kantoor

Jouw team

Je maakt onderdeel uit van het HR-team van EY Nederland, maar werkt primair voor EY-Parthenon. EY-Parthenon ondersteunt organisaties bij hun meest complexe strategische vraagstukken op het gebied van groei, transformatie, transacties en waardecreatie. Door strategie, uitvoering en diepgaande sectorkennis te combineren, ondersteunt EY-Parthenon klanten bij het realiseren van duurzame groei en blijvende impact.
Wat deze functie bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van zelfstandigheid en samenwerking. Je bent dé HR-contactpersoon voor EY-Parthenon en hebt daardoor veel eigenaarschap en invloed op alles wat met HR binnen deze praktijk te maken heeft. Tegelijkertijd sta je er nooit alleen voor: je werkt nauw samen met ervaren HR-collega's binnen EY en kunt altijd sparren met de HR Business Partner en HR Talent Lead.
Daarnaast werk je in een omgeving waar de lijnen kort zijn en je direct schakelt met senior stakeholders. Hierdoor heb je niet alleen zicht op belangrijke besluitvorming, maar kun je ook daadwerkelijk invloed uitoefenen op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie en haar medewerkers.
EY-Parthenon kenmerkt zich door een ondernemende, intellectueel uitdagende en resultaatgerichte cultuur. Collega's dagen elkaar uit om het beste uit zichzelf te halen, terwijl samenwerking, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en collegialiteit centraal staan.

Jouw kantoor

Je standplaats is Amsterdam (Zuidas). Daarnaast ben je bereid maandelijks aanwezig te zijn op ons kantoor in Den Haag en incidenteel te reizen naar Rotterdam, Zwolle en Eindhoven.

Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in de richting van Human Resource Management, Bedrijfskunde, Psychologie of een vergelijkbare studie.
Minimaal 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, bij voorkeur binnen HR of HR-consulting.
Je kunt goed luisteren, beschikt over sterke adviesvaardigheden en bent communicatief sterk. Dit stelt je in staat om effectief te adviseren en duurzame relaties op te bouwen met uiteenlopende stakeholders.
Je hebt een proactieve klant- en resultaatgerichte houding en bent in staat effectieve werkrelaties op te bouwen binnen een internationale organisatie met een partnerstructuur.
Je bent analytisch sterk en pakt werkzaamheden zelfstandig, proactief en gestructureerd op. Hierdoor weet je prioriteiten te stellen en kwaliteit te leveren in een dynamische omgeving.
Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift.
Je beschikt over een agile mindset en bent flexibel en aanpasbaar in je manier van denken en handelen. Je staat open voor verandering, zoekt voortdurend naar verbetering en hecht waarde aan teamwork.
Je weet zelfstandig te functioneren in een dynamische, veeleisende omgeving, maar stelt ook tijdig de juiste vragen of escaleert wanneer nodig.
Klantgerichtheid en een stevige persoonlijkheid zijn belangrijke eigenschappen, gecombineerd met enthousiasme, energie en drive.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier

Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Boven op je salaris ontvang je vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling).
Je krijgt een contract voor 40 uur.
Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding.
34 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken.
Met het mobiliteitsbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een leaseauto, een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app.
Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt.
De mogelijkheid om 20 werkdagen per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken.
De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen.
Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen.
Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing.
Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk.

En dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik hier

jobs.title: HR Manager Benelux | People Operations
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global leader in virtual care, with over 100 million users and more than 500 million annual healthcare interactions. We offer the only comprehensive virtual care solution that encompasses telemedicine, mental health, wellbeing, specialist medical advice and platform services.

Our Amsterdam team is growing. We are strengthening and scaling our local People Operations to create a consistent, employee-focused HR foundation for our continued growth in the Netherlands.

Role

A hands-on, high-execution role at the heart of our people’s function.

This position plays a key role in running day-to-day HR operations while contributing to Teladoc Health's people strategy in Amsterdam as we scale.

Teladoc Health is looking for a hands-on HR Manager to take ownership of People Operations in the Netherlands. In this broad and autonomous role, you will ensure that our HR operations, recruitment and employee processes run smoothly, while acting as a trusted people partner to the Country Manager and local Management Team.

You will be the primary HR contact for employees in the Netherlands and work closely with colleagues in our regional and global People & Culture organization. Your initial focus will be on operational excellence, Dutch employment-law compliance, recruitment and employee experience. As the local HR foundation develops, you will also contribute to workforce planning, organizational development and other strategic people priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end HR operations: contracts, onboarding, offboarding, payroll coordination, benefits administration, and employee records
Act as the first point of contact for employees on all people-related questions, from day-one logistics to day-to-day issues
Advise the Country Manager and local Management Team on people, organization and employment matters.
Ensure full compliance with Dutch labor law and internal policies, keeping documentation and processes audit-ready
Manage recruitment end to end for open roles, from job description to offer, as the main person driving the process
Build and continuously improve onboarding so new joiners ramp up quickly and feel at home fast
Take full ownership of HR processes day to day, prioritizing operational excellence and consistent execution over ad-hoc fixes
Identify gaps in current HR processes and implement practical, scalable improvements
Maintain accurate HR systems, trackers, and reporting so leadership always has an up-to-date picture of the team
Translate global People policies into effective local practices and identify where adaptation to Dutch requirements is needed.
Contribute to strategic people topics as they arise, including workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and org design input, while keeping operational delivery as the day-to-day priority

About You!

Experience

At least five years of broad HR experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for HR operations in the Netherlands.
Sound working knowledge of Dutch employment law and local HR practices.
Experience with employee relations, absence management, payroll coordination and end-to-end recruitment.
Experience in an international, fast-growing, startup or scale-up environment is an advantage.

Languages

Professional fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Digital skills

Strong digital proficiency, including experience with HRIS, payroll interfaces, reporting tools and Microsoft 365.

Soft skills

Essential: high execution power, approachable and easy-going manners, pragmatism, clear communication, with strong judgement, ownership, discretion, the ability to set priorities independently, and eagerness to grow with the company

Education requirements

Minimum studies: relevant degree or equivalent professional experience in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

Why join Teladoc Health

This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the Dutch HR agenda within an international healthcare technology organization. You will work directly with local leadership, collaborate with an international People team and have the mandate to deliver practical improvements that employees and managers experience every day.

Compensation and Benefits

The gross monthly salary for this role ranges from EUR 5,750 to EUR 7,000 based on a 40-hour working week, excluding 8% holiday allowance. The final offer will reflect the candidate’s relevant experience and fit with the scope of the role. In addition, we offer pension contribution, travel allowance, Teladoc Academy and a hybrid working arrangement.

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
As a People Business Partner at Sage, you work alongside the leaders who move the business forward, helping them build stronger teams, steer through change, and turn ambitious plans into results that hold up. You bring a clear point of view, a steady presence, and the kind of judgment leaders come to rely on. You tend to see what is coming before it arrives, and you are usually already thinking about what to do about it.

What you will own

Leading change that sticks. Guiding transformation, workforce planning, restructuring, and cross-functional projects with clear goals, visible sponsorship, disciplined communication, collaborator alignment, and enough structure to keep the right people moving together without slowing the work down.
Being the voice leaders rely on. Partnering with senior leaders as they set direction, offering clear guidance, candid input, and the kind of decision-focused meeting leadership that helps teams align quickly and leave with shared ownership of next steps.
Building teams that perform. Shaping talent, performance, engagement, and organizational design so people do their best work, teams pull in the same direction, and the business can grow without losing its footing.
Letting the evidence lead. Turning people metrics, patterns, and trends into choices you can defend, outcomes you can measure, and practical answers leaders can act on.
Solving the problems that do not come with a playbook. Spotting risk, gaps, and openings early, asking better questions, testing practical options, and bringing creative, sound answers before small issues grow into large ones.
Connecting the wider system. Working hand in hand with global P&C teams and Centers of Excellence while navigating complex employee relations, performance, and compliance matters toward outcomes that are fair, sound, scalable, and right for the business.

You will thrive here if

You meet leaders where they are. No two leaders are alike, and you adjust your approach to their style, context, pressure points, and readiness without losing your authenticity or lowering the bar.
You can translate without diluting. You know how to turn people strategy, policy, data, and change into language that makes sense to the leader in front of you, whether they need the headline, the risk, the options, or the next practical step.
You say what needs saying in a way it can be heard. You give leaders the straight version, even when an easier answer is sitting right there, and you know when to challenge, when to coach, and when to create space for them to get there.
You trust your own read. You are comfortable taking a position and standing behind it, and you bring original thinking instead of reaching for the default playbook.
You know the edge of what you know. When you are not certain, you say so and go find the answer, because getting it right matters more to you than appearing to have it all figured out.
You move with the business. Fast pace, shifting ground, more questions than answers? That tends to be where you do some of your best work, because you can bring enough structure, judgment, and calm to help leaders keep moving.

What you bring

Strategic Influence and Change Leadership

A track record of becoming the trusted voice behind business leaders in complex or global organizations.
Real experience guiding transformation and change, not just watching it happen around you.
A practical change-management toolkit: clear case for change, stakeholder mapping, sponsor alignment, communication cadence, manager enablement, adoption tracking, and reinforcement after launch.
The ability to shape thinking and direction at senior levels through influence rather than authority.

Business and People Expertise

Deep command of modern people practices, including organizational design, talent strategy, and workforce planning.
A history of translating business strategy into results-driven people plans.
Sound judgment in employee relations and the complex, human realities of organizational life.

Data and Insight

Genuine comfort with data, and the skill to turn it into recommendations people can act on.
Experience using metrics to prove what is working and improve what is not.

Project Management and Meeting Leadership

The ability to organize complex work into clear plans, owners, achievements, and follow-through that keep projects moving.
Confidence leading meetings that have purpose, pace, and outcomes, especially when the room includes senior leaders or competing points of view.
Strong facilitation skills that help groups focus, make decisions, resolve ambiguity, and leave knowing what happens next.

Agility and Execution

A calm, solution-first approach when priorities shift and the ground keeps moving.
The ability to hold competing demands and still deliver with both quality and pace.
Creative problem solving that combines curiosity, data, business context, and good judgment to move from ambiguity to a workable path forward.
A naturally collaborative style that connects easily across teams and geographies.

Leadership and Trust

Communication that engages, earns trust, and works at every level of the organization.
Emotional intelligence and balanced judgment, especially when the pressure is on.
A real commitment to inclusive practice and to building a culture of accountability, performance, and belonging.

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
As a People Business Partner at Sage, you work alongside the leaders who move the business forward, helping them build stronger teams, steer through change, and turn ambitious plans into results that hold up. You bring a clear point of view, a steady presence, and the kind of judgment leaders come to rely on. You tend to see what is coming before it arrives, and you are usually already thinking about what to do about it.

What You Will Own

Leading change that sticks. Guiding transformation, workforce planning, restructuring, and cross-functional projects with clear goals, visible sponsorship, disciplined communication, collaborator alignment, and enough structure to keep the right people moving together without slowing the work down.
Being the voice leaders rely on. Partnering with senior leaders as they set direction, offering clear guidance, candid input, and the kind of decision-focused meeting leadership that helps teams align quickly and leave with shared ownership of next steps.
Building teams that perform. Shaping talent, performance, engagement, and organizational design so people do their best work, teams pull in the same direction, and the business can grow without losing its footing.
Letting the evidence lead. Turning people metrics, patterns, and trends into choices you can defend, outcomes you can measure, and practical answers leaders can act on.
Solving the problems that do not come with a playbook. Spotting risk, gaps, and openings early, asking better questions, testing practical options, and bringing creative, sound answers before small issues grow into large ones.
Connecting the wider system. Working hand in hand with global P&C teams and Centers of Excellence while navigating complex employee relations, performance, and compliance matters toward outcomes that are fair, sound, scalable, and right for the business.

You will thrive here if

You meet leaders where they are. No two leaders are alike, and you adjust your approach to their style, context, pressure points, and readiness without losing your authenticity or lowering the bar.
You can translate without diluting. You know how to turn people strategy, policy, data, and change into language that makes sense to the leader in front of you, whether they need the headline, the risk, the options, or the next practical step.
You say what needs saying in a way it can be heard. You give leaders the straight version, even when an easier answer is sitting right there, and you know when to challenge, when to coach, and when to create space for them to get there.
You trust your own read. You are comfortable taking a position and standing behind it, and you bring original thinking instead of reaching for the default playbook.
You know the edge of what you know. When you are not certain, you say so and go find the answer, because getting it right matters more to you than appearing to have it all figured out.
You move with the business. Fast pace, shifting ground, more questions than answers? That tends to be where you do some of your best work, because you can bring enough structure, judgment, and calm to help leaders keep moving.

What You Bring

Strategic Influence and Change Leadership

A track record of becoming the trusted voice behind business leaders in complex or global organizations.
Real experience guiding transformation and change, not just watching it happen around you.
A practical change-management toolkit: clear case for change, stakeholder mapping, sponsor alignment, communication cadence, manager enablement, adoption tracking, and reinforcement after launch.
The ability to shape thinking and direction at senior levels through influence rather than authority.

Business and People Expertise

Deep command of modern people practices, including organizational design, talent strategy, and workforce planning.
A history of translating business strategy into results-driven people plans.
Sound judgment in employee relations and the complex, human realities of organizational life.

Data and Insight

Genuine comfort with data, and the skill to turn it into recommendations people can act on.
Experience using metrics to prove what is working and improve what is not.

Project Management and Meeting Leadership

The ability to organize complex work into clear plans, owners, achievements, and follow-through that keep projects moving.
Confidence leading meetings that have purpose, pace, and outcomes, especially when the room includes senior leaders or competing points of view.
Strong facilitation skills that help groups focus, make decisions, resolve ambiguity, and leave knowing what happens next.

Agility and Execution

A calm, solution-first approach when priorities shift and the ground keeps moving.
The ability to hold competing demands and still deliver with both quality and pace.
Creative problem solving that combines curiosity, data, business context, and good judgment to move from ambiguity to a workable path forward.
A naturally collaborative style that connects easily across teams and geographies.

Leadership and Trust

Communication that engages, earns trust, and works at every level of the organization.
Emotional intelligence and balanced judgment, especially when the pressure is on.
A real commitment to inclusive practice and to building a culture of accountability, performance, and belonging.

jobs.description:
We are building a lean, AI-enabled People function, and the Director of People Operations & Systems will own the infrastructure that allows it to operate accurately, efficiently, and at scale. This leader is accountable for our People systems ecosystem, people data integrity, payroll governance and controls, employee lifecycle operations, and the continuous redesign of People workflows through AI, automation, and self-service.
This is a builder role. You will inherit systems and processes that need to evolve, lead our transition to a modern HR technology environment, and create an operating model that reduces manual work while strengthening accuracy, controls, and the employee and manager experience. You will be close enough to the work to understand it deeply and step in when necessary, but your primary job is to build systems, controls, talent, and workflows that do not depend on you personally executing every transaction.
You will lead core People Operations capabilities, including payroll and benefits/compliance team members, and serve as the senior operational partner to Finance, IT, Legal, Security, Talent, and People leadership. The right person combines strong HR systems and payroll judgment with a first-principles mindset: you see a clunky process and ask not only how to automate it, but whether it should exist in its current form at all.
What You Will Own

People Systems & Technology

Own the People technology ecosystem and roadmap, including HRIS architecture, system governance, integrations, access, vendor performance, and continuous improvement
Serve as the internal business owner for our planned HRIS modernization, leading requirements, data migration, configuration decisions, testing, training, rollout, and adoption in partnership with implementation experts and cross-functional stakeholders
Ensure People systems are designed around scalable workflows, clear controls, manager and employee self-service, and reliable downstream data
Partner with IT and Security on integrations, access controls, system changes, and audit requirements across the People technology stack

People Data, Analytics & Controls

Own the integrity and governance of People data, including organizational structure, job architecture fields, compensation-related data, employee records, and reporting structures
Build proactive data-quality controls that identify discrepancies before they create payroll, reporting, compliance, or employee-experience issues
Develop scalable dashboards and self-service reporting that give leaders timely insight into headcount, hiring, turnover, compensation, and talent trends
Reduce reliance on recurring manual reports by redesigning reporting workflows and automating repeatable data delivery wherever practical

Payroll Governance & Operational Risk

Lead the payroll capability and provide senior oversight of payroll operations, with accountability for accuracy, timeliness, controls, documentation, audit readiness, and effective issue resolution
Manage and develop the payroll team member responsible for day-to-day payroll execution; remain sufficiently close to the work to review controls, interrogate payroll outputs, understand multi-state requirements, and step in during high-risk or exceptional situations
Establish clear review and escalation mechanisms across People and Finance, including independent controls for high-risk payroll changes and exceptions
Redesign payroll and payroll-adjacent workflows as systems and automation mature, shifting the function toward governance, exception management, auditing, and continuous improvement rather than manual processing

Employee Lifecycle & People Operations

Own the effectiveness of the operational infrastructure supporting onboarding, offboarding, employment changes, contractor lifecycle processes, I-9/E-Verify, and Employer of Record operations for international team members
Ensure workflows are accurate, compliant, well controlled, and increasingly self-service; the role owns the effectiveness of the operating system even when another team member or system executes individual steps
Partner with Finance, IT, Legal, Security, Talent, and People Business Partners to create clean handoffs and clear decision rights across employee lifecycle processes
Maintain a resilient operating model with clear documentation, backup coverage, escalation paths, and ownership for recurring People operations

Benefits, Compliance & Team Leadership

Lead and support the Benefits & Compliance capability, ensuring the team has clear priorities, escalation support, strong vendor partnerships, and an effective compliance operating rhythm
Own operational compliance infrastructure and audit readiness while partnering with subject-matter experts, Legal, Finance, brokers, and external advisors where specialized judgment is required
Clarify roles, decision rights, controls, and service expectations across People Operations; coach team members to operate at the appropriate level and build durable functional capability
Build capacity through systems, partners, automation, and role clarity rather than defaulting to additional headcount

AI-Enabled Operational Transformation

Continuously identify manual handoffs, administrative bottlenecks, recurring reporting cycles, and control points that can be eliminated, simplified, automated, or redesigned
Use AI and automation as core tools for operating-model redesign—not simply individual productivity—including exception detection, data-quality auditing, workflow orchestration, employee/manager self-service, and recurring operational processes
Evaluate workflows from first principles before automating them: remove unnecessary steps, clarify ownership, reduce middle-person handoffs, and preserve human judgment where risk or complexity requires it
Measure whether redesigned workflows improve capacity, speed, accuracy, control, or employee/manager experience, and iterate based on results

Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as the senior People Operations partner to Finance and Accounting on payroll controls, People data, workforce reporting, systems changes, and operating risk
Partner with IT and Security on systems architecture, integrations, access, and controls; with Legal on employment and compliance matters; and with Talent and People leadership on processes that depend on high-quality People data and infrastructure
Translate complex operational issues into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and decisions for People leadership and executive stakeholders

Requirements

8-12+ years of progressive People Operations, HRIS, HR technology, payroll operations, or related experience, including senior ownership of complex operational environments
Demonstrated experience leading a major HRIS implementation or transformation. Direct Rippling experience is strongly preferred; ADP Workforce Now experience is a plus
Strong payroll fluency, including controls, multi-state considerations, audits, exceptions, and the relationship between upstream HRIS data and payroll accuracy
Experience leading and developing operational team members and creating clear accountability across functions
Strong systems and data orientation: you can move between process architecture, data quality, reporting, integrations, controls, and practical execution
Evidence of redesigning workflows through automation, AI, self-service, or technology—not simply digitizing an existing manual process
Comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude as part of day-to-day problem solving, analysis, and workflow design
Strong analytical and spreadsheet skills, sound judgment, high attention to detail, and a bias toward durable solutions rather than workarounds
Ability to partner credibly across Finance, IT, Security, Legal, Talent, and senior People leadership, including navigating ambiguity and making clear recommendations
Working fluency in compensation and benefits operations is valuable; deep compensation strategy expertise is not required

How Success Will Be Measured

People data is trusted, governed, and increasingly self-correcting through strong controls

jobs.description:
Talent Partner - Referrals

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

We’re looking for an accomplished recruiter to partner with our UK referral network, identifying and engaging exceptional veterinary professionals within one of the most specialised talent markets in the profession.

Referral recruitment requires a distinctly proactive and relationship-led approach. Success in this role will be driven by your ability to understand specialist talent markets in depth, identify and engage individuals who may not be actively considering their next career move, and build credible relationships over the longer term.

Combining headhunting, executive search principles, talent mapping and market intelligence, you’ll develop sustainable pipelines of specialist veterinary talent in multiple disciplines while partnering with senior clinical leaders to deliver both immediate and future workforce requirements.

This is a fully remote, home-based role, with travel required for meetings, veterinary congresses and industry events across the UK and Europe.

How You’ll Make a Difference

You’ll take ownership of recruitment across a portfolio of specialist referral vacancies, acting as a trusted Talent Partner to senior clinical and commercial leaders across our network.

Developing a detailed understanding of individual clinical disciplines and their respective talent markets will be central to your success. You’ll use this insight to shape recruitment strategies, advise on market conditions and provide an informed perspective on talent availability, compensation, attraction, relocation and international recruitment.

A significant focus of the role will be the proactive identification and engagement of specialist veterinary talent. Through systematic market mapping, targeted search and sustained relationship management, you’ll develop networks and pipelines that extend beyond current vacancies and strengthen our long-term ability to attract exceptional clinicians.

You’ll also:

Lead sophisticated headhunting and search strategies across specialist referral disciplines, using market mapping, professional networks and targeted sourcing to identify and engage high-calibre talent across the UK and internationally
Build and maintain meaningful long-term relationships with specialist clinicians, developing sustainable talent pipelines and communities across priority disciplines
Partner consultatively with senior clinical and hospital leaders, providing market intelligence and using evidence to influence recruitment strategy, compensation positioning, attraction approaches and realistic hiring expectations
Manage complex recruitment processes from initial engagement through to appointment, including assessment, candidate management, offer negotiation, relocation and visa sponsorship where appropriate
Represent inspiring vet care at specialist veterinary congresses, professional events and networking forums across the UK and Europe, strengthening our presence and relationships within the referral community
Use recruitment data, talent intelligence and pipeline analysis to continuously refine recruitment strategies, strengthen direct hiring capability and reduce reliance on external agencies

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

You bring significant experience of recruiting within specialist or talent-scarce markets, together with a strong track record in headhunting and/or executive search.

You are skilled at looking beyond the active candidate market: understanding where specialist talent sits, developing a comprehensive view of the market and establishing credible relationships with individuals whose career decisions may develop over an extended period.

Previous veterinary recruitment experience would be advantageous but is not essential. Of greater importance is your ability to apply sophisticated search methodology, develop specialist market expertise and operate as a credible recruitment partner to senior stakeholders.

You’ll bring:

Demonstrable expertise in headhunting, executive search, talent mapping and proactive direct sourcing within niche, specialist or difficult-to-source markets
Proven ability to identify and engage passive talent, establish credibility and develop long-term relationships through extended recruitment cycles
Strong stakeholder consulting capability, with the confidence and credibility to influence and constructively challenge senior leaders
Highly developed candidate management, assessment, negotiation and closing skills, with a focus on delivering an exceptional candidate experience
Strong commercial judgement and the ability to interpret market intelligence and recruitment data to shape effective talent strategies and prioritise activity
Excellent research, communication and relationship-building skills, combined with a proactive, resilient and highly collaborative approach
Experience within veterinary recruitment, healthcare or another specialist professional market would be advantageous, as would exposure to international recruitment, relocation and visa sponsorship.

How We’ll Support You

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing.

You’ll join an experienced Talent team and work closely with colleagues and clinical leaders who bring extensive knowledge of the veterinary profession and our referral network. We’ll support you in developing detailed knowledge of referral disciplines, specialist career pathways and the clinical communities you’ll recruit within.

You’ll have the autonomy to build and develop specialist talent networks, shape sourcing strategies and establish your own presence within the referral community, supported by opportunities to attend leading veterinary congresses and professional events across the UK and Europe.

You’ll also have the opportunity to take a genuinely long-term approach to talent acquisition. Alongside delivering against current recruitment priorities, you’ll build the relationships, market intelligence and talent pipelines that strengthen our ability to attract specialist clinicians well into the future.

Work-life balance
26 days annual leave (Including bank holidays)
Cycle to Work scheme
Initiatives focused on employee wellbeing

Discounted staff pet care and pet insurance
Discounts and cashback across many popular retailers

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Provide independent, day-to-day HR partnership to assigned managers and employees, serving as a trusted resource for practical guidance and solutions.

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

The Opportunity

At SandboxAQ, People infrastructure is not a back-office function. It is the platform on which we build the employee experience.

We have strong foundations in place, and we are entering the next evolution of how we operate. As the company grows, we need someone who can build for today while designing for what comes next. What works at 300 people is not what works at 600, and this role is about helping us stay ahead of that curve.

We are looking for a HR Operations Lead to own and evolve our People Infrastructure in North America, with select global overlap. This is a senior role that is both hands on, as well as responsible for the work and execution of more junior team members. The right person will bring strong judgment, systems thinking, and a practical builder mindset. They will know how to create infrastructure and experiences that work for employees, managers, and the business at the same time.

This person will lead across systems, workflows, policy, service delivery, and operational design. They should be comfortable being hands on and running critical day-to-day operations, improving the architecture behind them, and bringing practical ideas (that you have implemented prior!) for how AI and agentic workflows can help us work smarter as we scale. Experience supporting organizational growth, change, and M&A integration is highly valuable in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Own HR Operations for North America across the employee lifecycle, while partnering on selected global processes and initiatives.
Lead operational excellence across employee changes, leaves, separations, compliance, documentation, and employee support.
Own and improve core HR systems, workflows, and operating infrastructure with a focus on scale, usability, control, and reliability.

Partner closely with the People Team, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and other stakeholders to improve how work moves across the business.
Identify friction, reduce manual work, and introduce practical uses of AI, automation, and agentic workflows to improve quality, speed, and scale.
Help the function evolve for the future by building infrastructure that can support a more complex organization over time, including periods of rapid growth, change, or integration.
Lead on select sensitive employee relations matters including investigations, policy review, and decision making
Drive strategic projects and programs to make us more future ready (ex: roadmap for tech stack changes, new global time off policies)

Essential Skills & Experience

Significant experience in HR Operations, People Operations, or HR systems-focused roles, with ownership of regional or multi-jurisdictional operations. Prior deliverables may include (but not limited to):
Technology evaluation, re-design and implementation (ex: new HRIS system)
Significant policy design and transition (ex: you made a large scale global policy change and drove the change management)
Redesigning work flows with the use of AI/agentic solutions
Experience leading complex employee relations matters (ex: difficult policy decision, standard employee investigation)

Minimum of 9+ years of progressive experience across HR systems, operational infrastructure, employee lifecycle processes, policy execution, and service delivery.
Someone who has held an HR Business Partner role (or similar employee facing role)
Prior people management experience, including meaningful experience coaching and developing junior team members.
Strong systems orientation and comfort with HRIS platforms, workflow tools, reporting, and process design.
Experience building or maturing contractor, consultant, or non-employee workforce processes.
Experience supporting company growth and change, with exposure to M&A, integration, or organizational transition work strongly preferred.
Ability to think beyond the current moment and design for where the company is going, not just where it is today.
Strong judgment, high discretion, and the ability to move fluidly between strategy and hands-on execution.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to turn ambiguity into clear action.
Experience in an AI-focused, high-growth, or highly innovative environment, with credible ideas for how AI and agentic approaches can level up HR Operations.

Highly Desired Skills & Experience

You are curious, highly responsive, and energized by building better ways of working.
You bring both creativity and pragmatism, and know how to balance fresh thinking with what will actually work.
You can see both the immediate operational need and the longer-term operating model behind it.
You care about quality and discipline, but you are not attached to process for process’s sake.
You like using technology to modernize work and improve the employee experience.
You know how to lead others while staying close enough to the details to keep the function sharp.
You want to be ahead of the competition versus waiting to see if what others are doing will work.
You are highly collaborative, stakeholder oriented, and communicative.

Why Join Us?

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work.

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Our Global Operations Recruiting team is dedicated to building world-class talent pipelines across Airbnb's most critical operational functions. We are a collaborative, data-driven group that partners closely with business leaders across Finance, Legal, HR, Trust, Customer Experience, to attract and hire exceptional talent at scale. We set the standard for recruiting excellence and take pride in delivering an outstanding candidate experience every step of the way.

The Difference You Will Make

As Recruiting Manager, Global Operations, you will lead a team of recruiters responsible for hiring across Airbnb's global operations functions, while also personally owning and running complex, senior-level searches yourself. This is a hybrid role: part strategic people leader, part expert practitioner. You bring a consultative approach, strong people leadership instincts, and deep operational acumen, and you're equally comfortable setting strategy for your team as you are rolling up your sleeves to run a search end-to-end. You are someone who thrives in ambiguity, builds with rigor, and holds both your team and your stakeholders to a high bar. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, and you will be expected to do both well.

A Typical Day

Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters across global operations functions, holding a high bar for performance, candidate experience, and partnership quality.
Personally lead end-to-end searches for senior and/or executive-level roles within Global Operations, from intake through offer and close, modeling the standard you expect from your team.
Serve as a strategic talent advisor to senior business leaders across Global Operations, translating hiring needs into executable recruiting strategies.
Own team-level goals, metrics, and reporting, proactively sharing data-driven insights with stakeholders and leadership to drive accountability and continuous improvement; represent the team in recurring global forums with funnel health and hiring-progress updates.
Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships with Finance, Employee Experience and Global Operations teams to align on headcount priorities.
Drive operational rigor across the full recruiting lifecycle, intake, sourcing strategy, pipeline management, offer execution, and closing, for both your team's requisitions and your own.
Proactively identify and resolve pipeline escalations, partnering with business leaders and cross-functional teams to address issues before they impact delivery.
Partner with Compensation, HR Business Partners, and Legal to navigate complex offer structures and ensure equitable, compliant hiring practices across global markets.
Develop scalable processes and frameworks to improve team efficiency, data integrity, and recruiter capacity planning.
Champion an exceptional, high-touch candidate experience, with particular attention to senior-level candidates, ensuring consistent and timely communication at every stage of the hiring process.
Exceptional data fluency with the ability to build, interpret, and present recruiting dashboards and pipeline analytics from the ground up; you do not wait for data to come to you, you architect the infrastructure, identify the gaps, and translate complex metrics into clear narratives that drive stakeholder alignment and inform hiring strategy at the leadership level
Establish yourself as a subject-matter expert and trusted voice in operations recruiting, both internally and in the broader talent market.
Contribute to cross-functional recruiting initiatives, including process design, tooling decisions, and recruiter development programs.
Represent the recruiting team in executive-level conversations, including capacity planning, headcount reviews, and quarterly business updates.

Your Expertise

9+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including a demonstrated track record personally leading senior-level searches, and at least 2 years managing and developing a team of recruiters.
Deep functional expertise in at least one Global Operations sub-function is highly preferred (e.g., Customer Support, Trust & Safety), not just general familiarity with operations hiring.
Demonstrated success recruiting for global operations, business functions, or non-technical roles at a technology company.
Proven ability to build trust and credibility with senior business leaders and act as a genuine strategic partner rather than a transactional hiring resource.
Experience conducting market research, talent mapping, and proactive pipeline-building for senior-level roles, not solely reactive, requisition-driven sourcing.
Strong data orientation with the ability to interpret pipeline metrics, forecast capacity needs, and translate insights into action.
Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder hiring environments across multiple geographies and business units.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
Proficiency with enterprise recruiting and HRIS tools such as Greenhouse, Workday, Gem or comparable systems.
A track record of building inclusive pipelines and championing diversity throughout the hiring process.
Genuine comfort carrying a personal search load alongside people leadership, this role requires the ability to lead strategically and operate hands-on, at a senior individual-contributor level, when the work demands it.

Your Location:

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in California or PST time zone
to be able to conduct their work. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

Description

Thought Logic Consulting is a functionally-led, digitally enabled consultancy that exists at the intersection of business transformation and technology innovation. We partner with clients to solve their most complex business problems and we do it in a highly collaborative, local-market approach, giving clients senior-level attention and giving our consultants room to grow, lead, and build.

The Role

The Talent Acquisition Manager, EPM will own recruiting strategy and execution for Thought Logic’s growing Enterprise Performance Management practice.

This is more than managing requisitions. We’re looking for someone who can become deeply embedded in the EPM ecosystem, build relationships across the OneStream, Oracle EPM, Pigment, and broader performance management communities, and develop the networks that help us find exceptional talent before we need it.

You’ll partner closely with EPM practice and business leaders to understand where the business is going, translate growth plans into talent strategies, and recruit across the full spectrum of the practice, including architects, developers, functional consultants, delivery leaders, practice leaders, and go-to-market talent.

This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who still loves the hunt, but also knows how to step back and think strategically about markets, talent pools, competitive intelligence, and long-term pipeline development.

What You'll Do

Own end-to-end talent acquisition for Thought Logic’s EPM practice, supporting hiring across OneStream, Oracle EPM, Pigment, and adjacent performance management technologies.
Build and maintain deep talent networks within the EPM ecosystem, developing relationships with high-value candidates well before an active hiring need exists.
Recruit across a broad range of roles, including solution architects, developers, technical and functional consultants, delivery leaders, practice leadership, sales, business development, and go-to-market talent.
Partner closely with EPM practice leaders to understand capability gaps, growth priorities, upcoming demand, and the talent required to support the future of the business.
Develop proactive sourcing and pipelining strategies for highly specialized and difficult-to-find talent.
Become a student of the EPM market, understanding key competitors, talent movements, certifications, technology trends, compensation dynamics, and where top talent sits.
Represent Thought Logic within the EPM community through conferences, industry events, user groups, networking opportunities, and other ecosystem activities.
Build authentic relationships across the OneStream, Oracle, Pigment, consulting, and partner communities that strengthen Thought Logic’s reputation as a destination for EPM talent.
Provide market intelligence and talent insights to practice leadership, helping influence hiring profiles, compensation decisions, location strategies, and workforce planning.
Develop creative approaches for engaging passive candidates who may not be actively considering a move.
Lead intake and calibration conversations with hiring leaders to ensure alignment on candidate profiles, evaluation criteria, and market realities.
Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from initial outreach through offer and close.
Use recruiting data and pipeline insights to identify challenges, adjust strategies, and help leaders make better talent decisions.
Collaborate across the Talent Acquisition team, sharing market knowledge, sourcing strategies, and relationships that can support broader firm growth.
Help continue building and improving Thought Logic’s recruiting processes, tools, employer brand, and overall approach to talent acquisition.

Who You'll Work With

EPM practice leadership responsible for growing our OneStream, Oracle EPM, Pigment, and broader performance management capabilities.
Consulting and delivery leaders who understand that great client work starts with great people.
Go-to-market and business development leaders helping expand Thought Logic’s presence within the EPM ecosystem.
A Talent Acquisition team that is continuing to build, experiment, and improve how we recruit.
Candidates ranging from highly specialized technical professionals to senior consulting and commercial leaders.
An executive team that views talent as a critical part of Thought Logic’s growth strategy and story.

What You'll Bring

At least 5+ years of talent acquisition experience, with meaningful experience recruiting within Enterprise Performance Management, Corporate Performance Management, financial systems, or closely related consulting and technology markets.
Existing knowledge of and relationships within the OneStream, Oracle EPM, Pigment, or broader EPM ecosystem.
Experience recruiting specialized consulting talent across technical, functional, architecture, delivery, leadership, and/or go-to-market roles.
Strong sourcing capabilities and a demonstrated ability to identify and engage passive talent in highly competitive markets.
The credibility to partner directly with senior practice leaders and challenge assumptions when market conditions or candidate feedback suggest a different approach.
A strong understanding of relationship-driven recruiting and the patience to develop talent communities that create value beyond an individual requisition.
Comfort representing an organization externally at conferences, industry events, networking opportunities, and within professional communities.
Experience recruiting within consulting, professional services, software, or another fast-moving environment where specialized talent is critical to growth.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple searches, pipelines, stakeholders, and competing priorities simultaneously.
Comfort using applicant tracking systems and recruiting technology. Experience with Pinpoint is a plus, but curiosity and adaptability matter more.
A builder’s mentality. You’re energized by creating networks, processes, strategies, and relationships rather than simply inheriting them.
The judgment to know when to move quickly, when to dig deeper, and when the right candidate is worth playing the long game.

Why Thought Logic

Own talent acquisition for a highly strategic and growing part of our business.
Become deeply connected to the EPM market rather than recruiting across dozens of unrelated technologies and skillsets.
Work directly with practice and executive leaders and have a real voice in how we approach talent and growth.
Help build Thought Logic’s presence and reputation within the OneStream, Oracle EPM, Pigment, and broader performance management ecosystems.
Join a growing consulting firm where recruiting has a direct and visible impact on our ability to serve clients and expand the business.
Have the freedom to experiment with new sourcing strategies, tools, events, partnerships, and ways of engaging the market.
Be part of a collaborative Talent Acquisition team that values ideas, relationships, creativity, and getting things done.
Build something with us rather than simply stepping into a recruiting machine that already exists.

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

There's so much we can tell you about this role and why we're excited about it, but to keep it brief, here are the top things you need to know. We're excited to receive your application and talk to you soon!

TL:DR: We're hiring an HR Business Partner to work with our Tech organization, supporting through an extraordinary phase of growth.

A role that matters. HRBPs are central to our People model - trusted by leaders, brought into important organizational challenges, and expected to have a point of view.

An exciting moment to join. We're scaling incredibly quickly, with strong pull from the business for People partnership and no shortage of high-impact problems to solve.
